name: Jake Duesenberg
subject: Can You Believe All of This
body:
| [ ](http://www.action4liberty.com/?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=can_you_believe_all_of_this&n=1)
---
Peter \-- I'm sure you've heard the news by now... Joe Biden had a "breakthrough" case of COVID following his failed trip to Saudi Arabia to solve rising gas prices - that were caused by him, by the way. **Jesse, Bridget and I came in hot and ready to talk about that and how the MNGOP is attacking its grassroots-conservative, endorsed candidates. There's so much to the story you probably haven't heard yet.** We didn't pull any punches. Please give it a watch: [](https://www.action4liberty.com/r?u=GQ96LxW7tJscudkL8mlwNzVEKXk7dMDJzwJlfbbiiRaG6037ERCexGc5hxdfoVpAbQrg5TRB-BTF2UTQKidyQA&e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=can_you_believe_all_of_this&n=2)
# [**WATCH NOW**](https://www.action4liberty.com/r?u=GQ96LxW7tJscudkL8mlwNzVEKXk7dMDJzwJlfbbiiRaG6037ERCexGc5hxdfoVpAbQrg5TRB-BTF2UTQKidyQA&e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=can_you_believe_all_of_this&n=3)
One of the last things we discussed on the show was the brand new Tim Walz Re-election video. Have you seen it? What a monster. He brags about his response to COVID and says he has been a good governor for business. And to make matters worse, he pretends like the economy is great in Minnesota. Someone is spending too much time trying to deceive voters. But here's the deal - politicians lie. You know they lie when their mouths are moving. And Tim Walz' mouth is moving A LOT! No one in the corporate media is going to call him out on it. And the same MNGOP that is attacking us and grassroots-conservative candidates, will be incapable of getting an effective message out against Tim Walz.
## That's where we step in.
My team has developed the best political booth the State Fair has ever had. We're going to go hard in the paint to EXPOSE Tim Walz' failures. **Our message will focus on how:**
* **Tim Walz locked down Minnesota, hurting education and businesses**
* **He let lawlessness in the cities spread**
* **Walz REFUSES to give back the surplus and help Minnesota families fight inflation**

There are over **2 Million people** who will attend the Minnesota State Fair this year. That means we can get this message in front of the largest audience of voters in the state. All I need to make this a BOOMING SUCCESS is for you to step up and pitch in some money. We have a lot of costs that goes into making a big splash, can I count on you to help me? | [](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate_state_fair_booth?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=can_you_believe_all_of_this&n=4 "Donate") [Donate](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate_state_fair_booth?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=can_you_believe_all_of_this&n=4)
---
We have over 70 people who have already volunteered to help us out by working a shift. But I need more volunteers to meet the demand of the audiences that form up around our booth.
**If you would like to help work a 6 hour shift, get a free t-shirt and a ticket to the fair, please click the link to volunteer. I'll have Bridget reach out to you right away.**
[](https://www.action4liberty.com/volunteer_state_fair_2022?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=can_you_believe_all_of_this&n=5 "Volunteer") [Volunteer](https://www.action4liberty.com/volunteer_state_fair_2022?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=can_you_believe_all_of_this&n=5)
---
You know the saying "there's only two things that are certain: death and taxes." Well, I think there is a third thing that is certain: the corporate media will not expose Tim Walz' true record of failures.
Remember when they buried the story of Hunter Biden a week before the 2020 election? That's what they're going to do to us in Minnesota.
## But you can counter it.
Help us get this extremely important message in front of the largest audience of voters by supporting our state fair booth.
[](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate_state_fair_booth?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=can_you_believe_all_of_this&n=6)
Tim Walz is setting fundraising records. The left is well organized, well funded and have the corporate media in their back pocket. If we don't fully fund our state fair booth, I fear our message will be overpowered by Walz' lies and propaganda.
You have the ability to STAND UP against the radical, liberal propaganda machine by supporting the one State Fair booth that will show fairgoers **Walz' Real Record of Failures**.
[**Donate $25, $50, $100 or more to make this year's booth a BOOMING SUCCESS. I can't do it without your help. Thanks!** ](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate_state_fair_booth?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=can_you_believe_all_of_this&n=7)
**In Liberty,**
****
**Jake Duesenberg**
**President, Action 4 Liberty**
Action 4 Liberty
1920 Oakcrest Ave #5
Roseville, MN 55113
Action 4 Liberty · United States
This email was sent to [dpwillis67@gmail.com](dpwillis67@gmail.com). To stop receiving emails, [click here](https://www.action4liberty.com/unsubscribe?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=can_you_believe_all_of_this&n=8).
You can also keep up with Jake Duesenberg on [Facebook](https://www.action4liberty.com/r?u=27Ax0UmWOX2J8J_QwK9Z6nyVoJL5zCIi1gu8lCoYmQrA8P7rhuOjJmdy-IRmglie&e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=can_you_believe_all_of_this&n=9).
Created with [NationBuilder](https://www.action4liberty.com/r?u=SWqLExi-4iBlEOa5qgO58jA2d62deOsOLwOgchKDecY&e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=can_you_believe_all_of_this&n=10), software for leaders.

name: Pete Sepp
subject: Do you want the truth about the economy?
body:
You and I don’t need to hear the White House or the mainstream media tell us any more sugar-coated opinions about the economy
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zdavsbjuumrattgip8r116hp1seq50c01ar3pnl8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s5ge2o31c1h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jmgr32t5nmepradrmeej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf8c35cqpb5cj0m5hj2t1mm9qm2tbmeur6fdbjc8pn8tr5c9oe2tbgmaq66s3mcurt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6coored9icurm8phkcsqr0ptgmlin49fg)
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ztl8r6kjm7482ao71p93cbn748nuslkfhqeq1iag_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s5ge2o31c1h2bs)
Friend,

You and I don't need to hear the White House or the mainstream media tell us any more sugar-coated opinions about the economy and inflation.

I want to share the truth with you... _even if it 's bad news you won't enjoy reading_.

**And the ugly truth is while there is no way to magically fix inflation, some of the worst outcomes could have been avoided.**

But the Biden administration is so out of touch with the needs of taxpayers that they have made a bad situation worse.

**If taxpayers ever needed a strong voice in Washington, it 's right now!**

Friend, National Taxpayers Union (NTU) is the most-heard, most-effective voice for taxpayers in Congress.

_The Hill_ , a DC insider publication, ranked two members of the NTU team as top lobbyists out of thousands in this town.

I know what you're thinking... _A lobbyist? How is that a good thing? _

Because we are fighting for millions of hardworking families, NOT special interest groups.

[_**Our mission is more important than ever. Can you donate $10, $35, $50, or any amount you can generously afford? Click here to donate >>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z19ejrtmu2p7ebc89ro9cecvd21alv15n0cucmqo_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s5ge2o31c1h2bs)

**Here 's an example of Biden's failures:** The White House is implementing numerous policies that are hurting American fossil fuel production. Now that prices are reaching record highs, he is blaming oil producers and demanding they increase their capacity and output. Even as he does this, he releases stock from the U.S. Strategic Petroleum Reserve, much of which is being shipped overseas!

At the same time, huge tariffs (taxes) on goods we buy have cost American families $136.5 billion and counting. President Biden has the power to relax these "Section 301" tariffs to boost competition and help reduce inflation.

_But Biden drags his feet. Worse, his budget advisors continue to push higher taxes and more federal spending as a "solution" to our economic woes, as if pouring gasoline on fire has ever been a good idea!_

**Friend, if you 're tired of Biden's economy, then I'm asking you to support NTU. **We are currently preparing for the next battles in Congress to stop the fiscal insanity in Washington. But it comes at a cost.

We must show them petitions, polling, media appearances, and pressure from staff lobbyists to stop disastrous policies. I am looking to raise $75,000 over the next three weeks before Congress goes back on recess.

**Your support will allow us to ramp up our operations and convince politicians in Washington that listening to the people who pay the government 's bills has to come first. **

[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ztog25mjuqpem0o7q6q9fceqmqft8u1ga7ncpp2g_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s5ge2o31c1h2bs)

It's not all bad news.

Recently, NTU played a critical role in halting Biden's Build Back Better plan that would have added **$5 TRILLION** in spending and debt.

And there is still a chance to turn the economy around. The government just needs to get out of the way! That means restoring reasonable federal expenditures, making the tax cuts enacted five years ago permanent, and keeping regulations prudent, so they don't strangle our businesses.

**NTU has been a part of EVERY single taxpayer victory since our founding in 1969. Your support can help us keep fighting on behalf of folks like you.**

We rely on Americans who believe in lower taxes and government spending at responsible levels - who believe in stopping and reversing the debt spiral propelling our great nation to ruin.

**Can you donate $10 or more and help NTU hold politicians accountable for enacting policies that actually help rather than hurt our economy? Select an amount below to donate.**

[_**Donate $10 >>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zhkif3l0etqm9b405lmn8dchocg67s2u2nll2r5o_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s5ge2o31c1h2bs)

I am looking to raise $75,000 over the next three weeks before Congress goes back on recess. Your support will allow us to ramp up our operations and convince politicians in Washington that listening to the people who pay the government 's bills has to come first. It's not all bad news. Recently, NTU played a critical role in halting Biden's Build Back Better plan that would have added $5 TRILLION in spending and debt. And there is still a chance to turn the economy around. The government just needs to get out of the way! That means restoring reasonable federal expenditures, making the tax cuts enacted five years ago permanent, and keeping regulations prudent, so they don't strangle our businesses. NTU has been a part of EVERY single taxpayer victory since our founding in 1969. Your support can help us keep fighting on behalf of folks like you. We rely on Americans who believe in lower taxes and government spending at responsible levels - who believe in stopping and reversing the debt spiral propelling our great nation to ruin. I wanted to reach out to you to share some reflections and a bit about why I am running for the United States Senate.
| | |
---
Friend, I had a few minutes of free time in my schedule today – which is a blessing these days as we sprint toward Election Day. But I wanted to reach out to you to share some reflections and a bit about why I am running for the United States Senate.
Running for office was not something I’d ever imagined I’d do when I graduated from law school. I had never seen an African American woman sit behind the bench until I was a practicing lawyer.
But it’s a moment that changed what I saw as possible, and I went on to run for judge myself. When my opponent said I couldn’t win as a young mom, I took my babies door to door and ended up winning that race by 30 points. Ultimately, I went on to win two statewide races and become the first African American woman to serve as Chief Justice of North Carolina.
Now, as I watch a politicized Supreme Court roll back our constitutional rights, I feel the urgent call to serve the people of North Carolina once again. My promise from the start of this campaign for U.S. Senate has been that I would pursue justice with a relentless refusal to see it abandoned.
Extremist Republicans are trying to bully me and buy this race. Their super PACs can keep spending millions on false attack ads against me, like they’ve already done. But I refuse to back down. I will not accept a future where our children have fewer rights than we did. We cannot go backward.
So I’m running this race to be a voice for people just like you, and if you help me win, I will cast the decisive 51st vote for progress – on abortion rights, voting rights, climate action, and more.
North Carolina has been rated by experts as one of only three likely pick-up opportunities for Democrats. But the truth, is I simply cannot do this alone.
**[So I’m humbly asking you to split a $3 contribution between my campaign and Maggie Hassan's today to help us flip this seat and expand our Senate majority. Diehl/Allen Supporters, Volunteers, and Concerned Citizens of Massachusetts:
We have many opportunities for you to help make this state better, by supporting the #DiehlAllen ticket for Governor and Lt. Governor. How can you help?
Join a Sign Standout to Promote the Campaigns
These are fun events, with lots of enthusiasm, honks, and waves. Here are two options on

name: Kelly, Mark
subject: Trump is coming back to Arizona
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Rosen for Nevada
body:
He knows how important this state is, and how important our race is
| | |
---
Friend –
In just a few hours, Donald Trump will be back in Arizona, and we expect his hand-picked candidate right on stage with him. Trump knows how important this state is, and how important our race is.
That’s why at one of his previous rallies here, he said: “Taking America back begins with kicking Mark Kelly the hell out of the United States Senate.”
And the truth is, if we don’t have the resources we need to win this race, he might get his wish. Millions of dollars have already been spent trying to defeat us, and millions more are coming. **If Trump can help flip this seat, he’ll be that much more likely to run in 2024. He might even win. **
Sorry to put that thought in your head, but it’s true.
**That’s why I need to know if you can make a $5 contribution before Trump comes tonight. Because when he does, a lot of people from the far right are going to start looking at this race. And after that, those same folks are going to start pouring money into Arizona to try to beat me. **

Dear Peter,

With your support we can build a more dignified economy for Wisconsin by crafting legislation that’s centered on the people closest to the issues - people like you and me. Please chip in [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/teamolikara?refcode=0722email] and help fuel this movement to change the future of our state and our country.

Button that says, "Chip in today!" with link to campaign donation page: [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/teamolikara?refcode=0722email]

Too many Wisconsinites are struggling to make ends meet while millionaires & billionaires in Congress fight amongst themselves. As your senator, I will build the diverse coalitions necessary to:
* Develop portable benefits for every worker in Wisconsin, including decoupling healthcare from employment;
* Offer free technical and vocational education;
* Target federal resources for entrepreneurs, veterans, and small & medium family farms;
* Protect workers’ right to organize and ensure a living wage;
* Establish universal broadband internet access.

In a dignified economy, workers are not only guaranteed a livable wage, they have the freedom to pursue work that’s meaningful to them because their healthcare isn’t tied to their job. If someone loses their job to automation, they should have access to free skills training and apprenticeships that help catapult them to the jobs of the future. These are just a few examples of what Wisconsin’s future could look like if you elect me as your Senator.

Please give what you can [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/teamolikara?refcode=0722email] to help us build a more dignified economy for Wisconsin. Together, we will shock the world and win this election on August 9th!

Steven

subject: CITIZENS FOR A GREATER GEORGIA ANNOUNCES KEY TARGET SEATS FOR 2022 CYCLE
body:
| | | |
---
| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE FRIDAY, JULY 22
CITIZENS FOR A GREATER GEORGIA ANNOUNCES KEY TARGET SEATS FOR 2022 CYCLE ATLANTA - Today, Citizens for a Greater Georgia, a State Senate Majority Leadership Committee, announced its target list for the 2022 cycle. The list includes battleground districts and potential pick-up seats - and is aimed at securing and growing the Republican State Senate Majority. Citizens will leverage its statewide field program to work with campaigns in target districts and in every senate district across the state - to get out the vote and keep Georgia's legislature red this November.
"Washington Democrats have driven a string of crises - resulting in record inflation, crime, and radical policies - that are crushing our families and communities," said State Senate Majority Caucus Chairman John F. Kennedy. "Georgians understand the stakes of the upcoming elections, and that local control matters more than ever. That's why Citizens for a Greater Georgia is focused on building the Republican State Senate majority in 2022, and beyond, to defend against the liberal agenda and ensure continued conservative leadership where it matters most." View the full target list below: Senate District 6 Republican Nominee Fred Glass Senate District 7 Republican Nominee Josh McKay Senate District 14 Republican Nominee Liz Hausmann Senate District 17 Republican Senator Brian Strickland Senate District 32 Republican Senator Kay Kirkpatrick Senate District 37 Republican Nominee Ed Setzler Senate District 45 Republican Senator Clint Dixon Senate District 48 Republican Nominee Shawn Still Senate District 56 Republican Senator John Albers ### Citizens for a Greater Georgia is a Leadership Committee representing a partnership between the Georgia State Senate Majority Caucus and former U.S. Senator Kelly Loeffler. I am beyond proud that the PACT Act has passed.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48167389/357188138/812264984?refcode=EM_FR_220722PACTAct_N_MK_90DO_7_NG_N_TESTB_logo_&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTY1NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZmFlZjE3NS1jYjA5LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VSa4IiHC3W15udN_fPm0naq-Q-9h4iAZA0dT4QshSWI=) Good news, team. The Senate just passed the bipartisan Sergeant First Class Heath Robinson Honoring Our Promise to Address Comprehensive Toxins Act of 2022, known as the Honoring Our PACT Act. Named after an Ohio veteran who passed away from cancer after being exposed to burn pits while deployed to Iraq, this act will improve health care and benefits for veterans who have been exposed to toxic substances. **This is a major win for veterans, service workers, and their families.** The PACT Act strengthens our commitment to the men and women who served America and ensures they are able to live with the dignity and comfort they deserve. I am beyond proud that this bill has passed. From burn pits, to radiation, to Agent Orange, toxic hazards are a major cause of ailment for veterans — something we must recognize. Luckily, this bill is a step in the right direction of addressing those impacts. As a senior member of the House Veterans Affairs Committee, it is my honor to advocate for veterans who have served our nation faithfully. A few years ago, I was proud to invite the family of a veteran who suffered a burn pit injury to be my guests at the State of the Union address. I felt it was important for my colleagues, and all Americans, to see the faces of those who sacrifice so much for us. That’s why the passing of this bill means so much – it’s a sign that all our hard work is truly paying off. [**_I was honored to fight for this bill, and I am proud to see it passed by the Senate. We need to fight together for those who fought for our country. Will you contribute $5 to our campaign today so I can keep advocating for veterans in Congress?_**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48167390/357188139/812264984?refcode=EM_FR_220722PACTAct_N_MK_90DO_7_NG_N_TESTB_l1_&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTY1NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZmFlZjE3NS1jYjA5LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VSa4IiHC3W15udN_fPm0naq-Q-9h4iAZA0dT4QshSWI=) Sincerely, [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48167391/357188167/812264984?refcode=EM_FR_220722PACTAct_N_MK_90DO_7_NG_N_TESTB_thumbnail&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTY1NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZmFlZjE3NS1jYjA5LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VSa4IiHC3W15udN_fPm0naq-Q-9h4iAZA0dT4QshSWI=) – Marcy Kaptur | Congresswoman Marcy Kaptur is a champion for the Midwest in Congress. subject: The enemy is within
body:
To view this email as a web page, go to the link below, or copy and paste it into your browser's address window.
https://view.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=5d33a8aaf896f995b2d16500dd22d83b49b710f7ef94f9efc0ee37127a44adb9a2ad3ac701e4a75da56af7850913e3c92f1bb1ad33b5ddcbd5d194f889ed2ff23518dca92ead344808674acaa5975aaa

Peter,

Our country is currently facing a great threat. A new enemy has emerged from the shadows that seeks to destroy and intimidate their way to a transformed state, and country, that you and I would hardly recognize.

This enemy is the radical vigilante woke mob that will steamroll anything and anyone in their way. Their blatant attacks on the American way of life are clear and intensifying: stifling dissent, public shaming, rampant violence, and a perverted version of history.

A group that will, literally, tear down monuments and buildings but — perhaps in an even more sinister way — tear down the American spirit itself. They go after the family unit, parental rights, traditional moral values, the church, and fact-based education.

Over the past few years, we’ve watched horrified as this group has attempted to brainwash our children into thinking we live in an evil, racist, irredeemable country.

We listened to them deny science and data to exert political theater all the while trampling over personal liberties enshrined in the Constitution.

We saw them take to the streets for an entire summer like outlaws burning, looting, and destroying everything in sight while being told they were “mostly peaceful” and “passionate.”

We watched Big Tech moguls in Silicon Valley be the arbiters of truth – deciding who gets to speak and who gets silenced through the digital public square.

We listened to the legacy media muffle legitimately verifiable news stories that didn’t align with their preferred narrative, only to watch the truth trickle out months later at a more politically expedient time.

Well, Peter, the time for listening and watching from the sidelines is over.

>> FIGHT BACK <<<" conversion="false" data-linkto="http://" href="http://secure.winred.com/rondesantis/the-enemy-is-within-hf" style="color:#0000FF;text-decoration:underline;" title=">>> FIGHT BACK
<<">>>> FIGHT BACK <<<

This enemy has taken over media, educational institutions, corporate boards, professional sports, foundations, and professional institutions. They have left no corner of our lives untouched. But all hope is not lost.

We The People still have a say. We know the truth, you and I, about America and the country she is and can be. We must fight to defeat these false pretenses and predetermined narratives.

I am choosing to counter this enemy with faith, with reason, and with freedom. As Governor of the Free State of Florida, I have chosen to lead with a vision that builds America up rather than tears it down.

Together we can ensure that our children are raised to know they live in the greatest state in the nation, the greatest country in the world, and that they have an opportunity to continue making them even greater.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=b5e860128212adf4470c07a162efc62d3d14552fb5efd28eeac359335d100c44996f1060fbaee0f5fc9089be826e493f93b400f5ca86c20975d544154ab33c12
If you’ve been waiting for the right time to get off the sidelines and fight for the rights you know were given to man by God Himself – the time is NOW.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=b5e860128212adf4470c07a162efc62d3d14552fb5efd28eeac359335d100c44996f1060fbaee0f5fc9089be826e493f93b400f5ca86c20975d544154ab33c12
If you’re with me, Peter, chip in any amount to help me defeat this enemy. I can’t do it without you. I promise you; I will never stop fighting.

Sincerely,
Ron DeSantis

name: Read/Act News
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| [](http://trk.readactnews.) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives-but supported by many well-meaning Americans-to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue-views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://trk.readactnews._xcEg)** For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics-too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale's Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty-including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://trk.readactnews.)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding-not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention-and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Fellow American,
We knew it was just a matter of time before another woke company canceled us... but we didn't see this one coming.
A few weeks ago, we received an unexpected email from Front, the company that manages all inbound and outbound email for the team here at the Babylon Bee, informing us that they had terminated our account, effective immediately.
Sure enough, moments later, we were unable to send or receive email.
For weeks afterwards, our team scrambled. We’re a company spread across multiple cities, so email is essential to our operation. Needless to say, this one hurt. Front decided to drop the bomb on us in whatever way would disrupt us the most, and they succeeded.
But _why_ would they do such a thing?
By now, I'm sure you have a good guess.
It probably comes as no surprise that Front is run by a group of woke, left-wing tech elitists. Just like Twitter, Facebook, _The New York Times_ , Snopes, and the many other companies that have attacked us, they simply can’t abide satire that dares to mock their left-wing orthodoxy.
So they orchestrated their attack to do the most damage they possibly could.

Peter, that’s me you’re looking at.

It was 1976. I was in my senior year at Fort Hamilton High School in Brooklyn, and I was scrambling to figure out what direction I wanted my career to go in. I knew that I was lucky to even have the opportunity to decide what I wanted to do next. So many people from my school didn’t have that luxury.
But every time I thought about what career I wanted to pursue, I kept coming back to the civil rights marches and protests that I encountered when I was younger. The Civil Rights Movement consumed the better part of my childhood, and it instilled a fiery passion for justice and equality in me from a young age.

As a child, I loved to read. I remember getting lost in the stacks and picking up a book on Justice Thurgood Marshall. It was then, inspired by his story, that I first began to toy with the idea of law school – at a time when so few lawyers were Black or female, let alone both. I knew that having a law degree would be a valuable tool in the fight for justice and equality, so I decided to pursue law school despite the high barriers to entry.
**Back then, I didn’t know that my fight for justice and my interest in law would take me to elected office – and I definitely never pictured myself becoming attorney general of New York. All I knew was that I wanted to help families like my own,_and that’s exactly what I’ve done. _**
Peter, I’ve spent every moment as attorney general fighting to protect the voiceless and vulnerable – but I need your help to continue my work. **I’m up for re-election this November, and I have to defeat my Republican opponent to continue to fight as your attorney general for another four years, so please: **
**[Will you make a donation of $5 or more to my campaign now so I can defeat my GOP opponent, continue to hold the powerful and corrupt accountable, and fight for justice?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48170015/357199179/379053316?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk607-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTg0OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMDIxYWRhMy1jZjA5LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5bUX7dIiIirAEsyd_9ji0USYSEhWua7DhBX69s68V4w=)**

Bucks County Board of Elections receives envelope with 'suspicious substance [https://www.buckscountycouriertimes.com/story/news/crime/2022/07/18/suspicious-substance-sent-to-bucks-county-election-board/65376502007/] An expletive-laden letter, filled with a suspicious substance, was sent to the Bucks County Board of Elections Monday. (via Courier Times) [https://www.buckscountycouriertimes.com/story/news/crime/2022/07/18/suspicious-substance-sent-to-bucks-county-election-board/65376502007/]
The Supreme Court must reject the independent state legislature “theory” [https://www.brennancenter.org/stop-the-power-grab?fbclid=IwAR122cFKwzW6el9Xog6CV-OqKjuZB_Y-htTdaiR1eX_v1GSWHtlUWwTsz50] The so-called independent state legislature “theory” is a radical and baseless doctrine pushed by fringe lawyers and lawmakers – but the Supreme Court has decided it will hear the case this fall. (via Brennan Center) [https://www.brennancenter.org/stop-the-power-grab?fbclid=IwAR122cFKwzW6el9Xog6CV-OqKjuZB_Y-htTdaiR1eX_v1GSWHtlUWwTsz50]
PA One of At Least 7 States That Could Restrict Abortion Rights via Constitutional Amendment [https://www.post-gazette.com/news/politics-state/2022/07/17/pennsylvania-states-restrict-abortion-via-constitutional-amendment/stories/202207150140] When Pennsylvanians woke up last week to the news that they could soon be voting on whether the state should declare there is no right to an abortion here, they weren’t the only ones. (via Pittsburgh Post-Gazette [https://www.post-gazette.com/news/politics-state/2022/07/17/pennsylvania-states-restrict-abortion-via-constitutional-amendment/stories/202207150140] )

(via PennLive) [https://www.pennlive.com/news/2022/07/out-of-abortion-issues-shadow-gop-election-related-amendments-could-bring-big-changes.html]

It has been a busy summer in Washington, and I am pleased to report that under our strong Democratic leadership, the House has been able to accomplish a lot over the last few months.
We all can agree that something must be done about the tragic epidemic of gun violence our nation is facing. I was proud to support the **Bipartisan Safer Communities Act** , recently signed into law by President Biden, that included measures from my **Extreme Risk Protection Order Act** which will help states set up and strengthen red flag laws to keep guns out of the hands of individuals who are at risk of harming themselves or others. This bill is an important first step on our path to ending gun violence and enacting the commonsense gun safety legislation our country desperately needs.
I am also committed to fighting for and protecting women's reproductive rights, now more than ever in light of the Supreme Court ruling overturning Roe v. Wade. I recently voted to pass two bills, the **Women 's Health Protection Act**, which restores the fundamental right to reproductive health care for everyone, and the **Ensuring Women 's Right to Reproductive Freedom Act** , which guarantees the right to travel for reproductive care so people nationwide can find safe harbor in states without prosecution.
As we know, the recent ruling against Roe can quickly become a slippery slope for many of our other fundamental rights, and I am proactively doing everything I can to ensure those rights are protected. I was proud to co-sponsor and vote for the **Respect for Marriage Act** to enshrine marriage equality for same sex and interracial couples, repeal the discriminatory Defense of Marriage Act (DOMA), and provide additional legal protections for marriage equality. Marriage equality is a fundamental right and we must do all we can to prevent far-right justices from taking it away.
Finally, I would be remiss not to mention the issue currently on the minds of millions of Americans right now: inflation. I was proud to help pass the **Lower Food And Fuel Costs Act** , a package of bipartisan bills to lower prices for America's families in the grocery aisle and at the gas pump, and will continue the fight for fair wages and better paying jobs.
The House has been able to accomplish a lot, and will continue to work on legislation to improve lives throughout our country. But as you know, the midterm elections are just over three months away, and Democrats run the real risk of losing the House majority if we don't act now. [_**We can 't take any seat for granted, including mine, and I hope I can count on you to click here and chip in today to help fund my campaign.**_](https://act.myngp.com/el/QM1oFDHjyFEKSbR_KUe2Ikw-6E52gw0lDs504RkicwE=/c0wMJLzz-K9Cn_LRALUyH6XFdC9PO-aLJu4-x42y6aM=?am=&recipientId=cDmLEpJFmDvVxlWX7upKG1&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com)
Thank you for taking the time to read about some of our recent accomplishments, and for [**_chipping in_**](https://act.myngp.com/el/QM1oFDHjyFEKSbR_KUe2Ikw-6E52gw0lDs504RkicwE=/c0wMJLzz-K9Cn_LRALUyH6XFdC9PO-aLJu4-x42y6aM=?am=&recipientId=cDmLEpJFmDvVxlWX7upKG1&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com) to help me continue our work. I appreciate your support and look forward to staying in touch as we continue to find solutions to our nation's challenges.
Sincerely,
Salud Carbajal

name: Peter Franchot
subject: Statement on Results of the Gubernatorial Primary Election
body:
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81826/images/FAWlogo_Blue%404x.png]
Dear Peter,
I congratulate Wes Moore and Aruna Miller for running a successful campaign and becoming the Democratic nominees for governor and lieutenant governor. With voting rights, Roe v. Wade, health care, common sense gun control, climate change, and economic stability being the key issues of this moment, it is vital that Marylanders come together to elect a Democrat to be the next governor. I stand ready to ensure this happens and encourage Marylanders to make sure their voices are heard in November!
I am incredibly grateful to all of our supporters and volunteers who believed in our vision for a competent government that gets results every Marylander can see and feel and for all Marylanders to share in the prosperity of the State -- especially those who often feel they are left on the outside. I am proud that despite the tone this election sometimes took, we ran a positive campaign and maintained our commitment to our values. We did not attack or disparage, or seek to anger and divide. We focused on issues and the voters, and gave voice to thousands of Marylanders who shared our vision. I want to especially thank my family and staff who have stood by my side and gracefully endured this Campaign. Additionally, I would like to thank Monique Anderson-Walker for being my lieutenant governor candidate and her family for their steadfast support at all levels of this campaign.
It has been an honor to foster new relationships and strengthen current ones with Marylanders. I continue to be inspired by our robust culture and diversity. As I complete my tenure as comptroller, I am committed to ensuring that Maryland is positioned to navigate the economic challenges ahead so that we can continue to grow and prosper for generations to come.
Thank you,
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81826/images/Franchot%20Signature.png]

clean_body: [] Dear Peter, I congratulate Wes Moore and Aruna Miller for running a successful campaign and becoming the Democratic nominees for governor and lieutenant governor. With voting rights, Roe v. Wade, health care, common sense gun control, climate change, and economic stability being the key issues of this moment, it is vital that Marylanders come together to elect a Democrat to be the next governor. I stand ready to ensure this happens and encourage Marylanders to make sure their voices are heard in November! I am incredibly grateful to all of our supporters and volunteers who believed in our vision for a competent government that gets results every Marylander can see and feel and for all Marylanders to share in the prosperity of the State -- especially those who often feel they are left on the outside. I am proud that despite the tone this election sometimes took, we ran a positive campaign and maintained our commitment to our values. We did not attack or disparage, or seek to anger and divide. We focused on issues and the voters, and gave voice to thousands of Marylanders who shared our vision. I want to especially thank my family and staff who have stood by my side and gracefully endured this Campaign. Additionally, I would like to thank Monique Anderson-Walker for being my lieutenant governor candidate and her family for their steadfast support at all levels of this campaign. It has been an honor to foster new relationships and strengthen current ones with Marylanders. I continue to be inspired by our robust culture and diversity. As I complete my tenure as comptroller, I am committed to ensuring that Maryland is positioned to navigate the economic challenges ahead so that we can continue to grow and prosper for generations to come. Thank you, [] By Authority: Franchot Anderson-Walker for Maryland Slate; Thomas C. Brennan, Treasurer. name: Harriet Hageman
subject: Send Liz Cheney packing
body:
This will be the most important race in the entire country... |
Friend,

Will you help me FIRE Liz Cheney and take back our conservative movement from the elitist establishment that is working arm-in-arm with Joe Biden?

No sooner had President Trump endorsed my primary challenge to Liz Cheney did she shoot back with her usual arrogance to "bring it."

[**Well, I'm counting on you to help me bring it by chipping in with an emergency donation to my campaign to FIRE Liz Cheney.**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64775%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=YIN%2fJvhz1%2fyhRLl0bcZssQ&sysid=1) [DONATE NOW](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64776%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=aXj5%2f0pVBFVjTOQJ%2fKvjSA&sysid=1)
You and I don't have a moment to lose...

That's because establishment elitists, like George W. Bush, headline ritzy fundraisers in other states to raise millions for Cheney.

That was even after Cheney admitted in a 60 Minutes interview that her record-breaking fundraising haul was helped out by Democrats.

If there was ever a time for conservative Americans to stand up to the elitist establishment, it's now. And it's against Liz Cheney.

[**Will you help me stand up with an urgently needed donation today?**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64777%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=0Mq%2fUADnn8KBJLVY0FERYg&sysid=1)

I'm getting ahead of myself.

Before you decide to give to my campaign to FIRE establishment-anointed Liz Cheney from Congress, **let me tell you a little about who I am, why President Trump endorsed my primary challenge, and why we need your immediate help.**

My name is Harriet Hageman, and Wyoming is my home.

Growing up on a ranch outside Ft. Laramie, I learned the value of hard work, integrity, self-sufficiency, and honesty from an early age.

They're not just values Joe Biden and his socialists hate - they run absolutely counter to the establishment elites who have for too long controlled our Republican Party... and sold out our country to the highest bidder.

**I should know - like many in my state, and many more around the country, I was duped by these same "Republicans."**

**And as a constitutional lawyer who fought against Bill Clinton's EPA regulations, I watched in disgust as establishment elites like Liz Cheney embraced big government and abandoned our conservative values.**

Unfortunately, it's only gotten worse since President Trump left office.

And now, backed by their friends on the left and the media, Cheney and the establishment are waging a full-blown war on Americans like you and me!

[**No more. Will you support my campaign to defeat Liz Cheney by making an emergency donation today? I'll be honest, her LIBERAL big money backers are putting millions of dollars into her campaign right. Without your help, I don't stand a chance.**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64778%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=KTT0nMxuVc51ZHZ%2fSn2AZw&sysid=1) [DONATE NOW](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64776%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=aXj5%2f0pVBFVjTOQJ%2fKvjSA&sysid=1) As I said at the start of this email, **President Trump is 100% behind me.**

He knows the people of Wyoming - and the _American_ people - deserve better than Cheney, and he knows I'll never abandon our conservative values once elected to Congress.

In Wyoming, we have a long and proud history of standing up against an overbearing government.

In Washington, I promise to do the same...

...unlike Cheney, who spends more time fist-bumping Joe Biden and complimenting Nancy Pelosi than she does fighting back against big government bureaucrats who _waste our tax dollars_ , _fling open our borders_ , and _silence, censor, and even lock up conservatives_ who disagree!

**But even though I have President Trump's complete and total endorsement, there's one endorsement I still need: yours.**

[**Will you make an donation today to show President Trump that you're still a part of his MAGA-America First Movement?**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64779%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=palrhTxJJGPWrEBRz%2f9BJQ&sysid=1) [DONATE NOW](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64776%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=aXj5%2f0pVBFVjTOQJ%2fKvjSA&sysid=1) You should know that, even though polls show Cheney is grossly unpopular in Wyoming, she still thinks she can win re-election.

**In fact, when liberal _60 Minutes_ asked her if she could beat me in the primary, she said "absolutely...this is going to be the most important House race in the country."**

Well, she was right about something - this will be the most important race in the entire country - but only because it will be the first step in saving America from the big government elites who enable Joe Biden.

Again, I'll need your help to beat her.

As I said, Cheney can count on the deep pocketbooks of the entire establishment.

That's not even saying anything for her left-wing supporters, who see this as their chance to weaken our Republican Party for good.

**But with your help, I know we can beat them. And I know we can send the disastrous Cheney political dynasty packing for good.**

[**So please, won't you ensure that Liz Cheney bury me, a true conservative, with money from her swampy elite friends?**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64770%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=WPKj2fw5qJglW6a15hXwiQ&sysid=1) [DONATE NOW](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64776%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=aXj5%2f0pVBFVjTOQJ%2fKvjSA&sysid=1) Liz Cheney represents everything the left stands for, and everything we must fight against.

Will you help me make sure we win that fight?

Respectfully,
[](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64771%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=GaOQ%2fdrVKlSQpx%2b7xHAC1Q&sysid=1)
Harriet Hageman
America First Conservative for Congress (WY)

P.S. It's disgusting to see Liz Cheney teaming up with George Bush to demonize conservatives and raise millions to back Nancy Pelosi's unconstitutional power grabs in Congress.

It's even more disgusting to watch her claim she speaks for the people of Wyoming and America.

[**No more - will you make an urgent donation to my campaign to defeat her in the Republican primary?**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64772%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=trdvxShCtR7qQGNHoB%2bJkA&sysid=1) [DONATE NOW](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64776%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=aXj5%2f0pVBFVjTOQJ%2fKvjSA&sysid=1)

Dan knows how tough it is for working families and is committed to lowering costs for people every day. From gas and groceries to prescription drugs, he is standing up to price gouging companies to ensure that hardworking people don’t get the short end of the stick. And he’s worked with Republicans and Democrats alike to support fair trade deals that bring back Michigan manufacturing.

For Dan, elected office is not about scoring political points or getting likes on social media. It’s about making sure that working families can put food on the table, pay rent or mortgage, and support their families.

**Dan is in office to improve the lives of mid-Michiganders, not play party politics.**

We have been fighting for Michigan since 2012
| | | |
---
---
| Peter,
I woke up one chilly Michigan morning in March 2020, and my husband, Ryan, told me that our Governor was closing the schools because we had TWO CASES of the coronavirus in our state.
I laughed and thought he was kidding. The entire state of Michigan was closing its schools because of 2 cases? Sounded like a scam to me.
The last I had heard of the coronavirus, was that it was released by some Chinese lab, most likely owned by Bill Gates, but who knows anymore these days?
I'm sure many of you were just as shocked as I was in March 2020, when our lives were flipped upside down by the Government, showing us how our daily lives could be affected by the whims of a tyrant, like Gretchen Whitmer.
In the last 2 and 1/2 years, we were all given a crash course in politics, and the impact the Governor can have on a state.
Not only have small businesses been crushed, people are FORCED to take experimental medicines that they don't want and are forbidden to take safe medicine that they DO want.
Our children were victimized by the Michigan government and made to "stay home, stay safe."
They were told to cover their beautiful faces with dirty pieces of cloth!
They were, and still are, being indoctrinated by our media and school systems, and now the unborn are being targeted by the Democrats' desire to make late-term abortion a constitutional right.
This is all at the hands of the failed "leadership" in our state. Too many people in our state have had to die or suffer unnecessarily because of Michigan government overreach.
---
---
From the VERY BEGINNING our family has been fighting against tyranny.
We have been out in the streets of Michigan, teaching Michigan residents that in this country and state, we have God-given freedoms, not government-given freedoms.
Even as far back as 2012, we were helping NoGMO4Michigan fight against Monsanto, by insisting on GMO labeling, so Michiganders could know what was in their food.
The fight is not over. This is only the beginning. We have a lot of work to do to get this state back on the right track to bring Freedom, Hope, Love and Prosperity back to Michigan.
Peter, If you want a Governor and a FIRST FAMILY that will lead the fight for freedom in Michigan, elect my husband Ryan Kelley in the August 2nd primary election and donate to his campaign TODAY.

Every day, it becomes clearer that Mondaire is the best candidate to lead NY-10.
We need Mondaire’s leadership in Washington, and here are just three reasons why:

With the Court overturning _Roe_ and our other fundamental rights under threat, we need to keep Mondaire fighting to defend our democracy and restore balance to our nation’s highest court.

| _**ABOUT ROD**_

Rod Dorilás is the first-generation son of two immigrants from Haiti. His father immigrated to Florida to pick crops, and eventually his parents went on to own a small business. From a young age, his parents instilled in him the importance of hard work, integrity, and service.

At age 17, Rod enlisted in the United States Navy, serving for six years as a Petty Officer Second Class and Assistant Engagement Control Officer onboard the USS The Sullivans, stationed in Jacksonville. There, he was responsible for planning and executing the deployment of Tomahawk Land Attack Missiles on the Ballistic Missile Defense destroyer.

Upon completion of his military service, Rod attended law school at Syracuse University with the help of the G.I. Bill. After graduating, he served in President Trump's Administration in the U.S. Department of Commerce. While serving our great nation, Rod fought tirelessly to ensure that American families and businesses weren't taken advantage of by China.

Rod is a true public servant and is dedicated to serving his country and community. He wants to ensure that every American, through hard work and perseverance, can achieve the American Dream. #
This is urgent, Peter.

name: Richard Walker
subject: Fauci’s influence over medical schools needs to end. Here’s how you can help
body:
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60856974:6hD0AsVBN:m:1:3317145305:33432FE129400F2B3AEA9D0D7B350E10:r)

Peter,

Dr. Anthony Fauci cares more about his fame and pushing his healthcare agenda than about doing his job.

Even the Wall Street Journal recently called him out.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60856974:6hD0AsVBN:m:1:3317145305:33432FE129400F2B3AEA9D0D7B350E10:r)
That hasn't stopped medical schools from teaching students to worship at the altar of managed care instead of focusing on how to deliver quality care.

Peter, The Benjamin Rush Institute (BRI) is fighting back.

My name is Richard W. Walker, the Executive Director of Benjamin Rush Institute.

BRI is a nonpartisan organization that believes everyone suffers when bad healthcare regulations undermine the patient-doctor relationship. Our mission is to educate medical students about positive, proven healthcare policies that preserve and protect the Doctor-Patient relationship.

[_**Can you join the fight against Fauci 's influence with a donation of $1,000, $500, $250, $100, $50, or even just $25? Click here to send your gift >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60856974:6hD0AsVBN:m:1:3317145305:33432FE129400F2B3AEA9D0D7B350E10:r)

**Here 's the problem: medical schools are training students to be "woke" political activists, NOT doctors.**

Most medical students today are instructed in healthcare policy that promotes a government-mandated, insurance company approach to healthcare.

They rarely -- if ever -- encounter a voice promoting free enterprise and the sanctity of the patient-doctor relationship.

_You and I MUST show these students an alternative_.

Medical students need to know the truth about free-market healthcare and the medical establishment. Otherwise, our healthcare system will succumb to the wishes and dictates of the government bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci.

[_**Click here to support a student with a donation of $25, $50, or any amount >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60856974:6hD0AsVBN:m:1:3317145305:33432FE129400F2B3AEA9D0D7B350E10:r)

BRI creates chapters on campuses across the country, connects with students, and reaches future medical professionals in-person and online.

We are giving medical students a voice and the empowerment to overcome the push towards socialized, over-regulated healthcare.

Here's where your support will go.
* Your gift of just $25 will support the next edition of BRI's popular, student-produced Virtual Event Series. [_**Donate $25 Here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60856975:6hD0AsVBN:m:1:3317145305:33432FE129400F2B3AEA9D0D7B350E10:r)

* A $50 donation will promote an episode of BRI's Truth in Liberty series, also student-produced, that presents first-hand accounts from patients, physicians, and others who have endured political oppression and medical tyranny. [_**Donate $50 Here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60856976:6hD0AsVBN:m:1:3317145305:33432FE129400F2B3AEA9D0D7B350E10:r)

* A $100 gift will underwrite the spring semester's popular NexGenMed student-produced podcast on iTunes--now available on Amazon Music and soon to be available on Spotify. [_**Donate $100 Here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60856977:6hD0AsVBN:m:1:3317145305:33432FE129400F2B3AEA9D0D7B350E10:r)

* A $250 donation will cover scholarship expenses--travel and conference fees--for a BRI student member to attend conferences such as the annual meeting of the Free Market Medical Association. [_**Donate $250 Here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60856978:6hD0AsVBN:m:1:3317145305:33432FE129400F2B3AEA9D0D7B350E10:r)

* A $500 gift will fund a speaker to travel to a medical school and make a case for free enterprise in healthcare. [_**Donate $500 Here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60856979:6hD0AsVBN:m:1:3317145305:33432FE129400F2B3AEA9D0D7B350E10:r)

* A $1,000 donation will support a BRI medical student chapter for an academic year. [_**Donate $1,000 Here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60856980:6hD0AsVBN:m:1:3317145305:33432FE129400F2B3AEA9D0D7B350E10:r)

Actions by healthcare "leaders" like Dr. Fauci have put our medical schools and the healthcare industry in mortal danger!

You and I are at risk of the U.S. Healthcare system succumbing to social justice propaganda, big government mandates, and joining the ranks of Europe's costly socialized medical system.

Fortunately, our message resonates with students, and we are winning hearts and minds.

These students haven't been fooled into believing woke medical nonsense like
* It's wrong to question government vaccine mandates or regulations.
* Hormone treatments should be given to children.
* Being obese is a perfectly acceptable lifestyle.

They are hungry for an alternative. They believe in free enterprise and the sanctity of the patient-doctor relationship.

**But if we don 't reach these students, their voices will be silenced by the radical activists who have taken over medical schools across the country.**

Last week, I set a goal to raise $48,000 by the end of the month to fund BRI's on-campus chapters. Can you help BRI reach our goal before the fall semester starts?

**Click below to send your urgent donation today.**
[_**Send $25 to BRI >> **_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60856975:6hD0AsVBN:m:1:3317145305:33432FE129400F2B3AEA9D0D7B350E10:r)
[_**Send $35 to BRI >>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60856981:6hD0AsVBN:m:1:3317145305:33432FE129400F2B3AEA9D0D7B350E10:r)
[_**Send $50 to BRI >>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60856976:6hD0AsVBN:m:1:3317145305:33432FE129400F2B3AEA9D0D7B350E10:r)
[_**Send $100 to BRI >>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60856977:6hD0AsVBN:m:1:3317145305:33432FE129400F2B3AEA9D0D7B350E10:r)
[_**Send $250 to BRI >>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60856978:6hD0AsVBN:m:1:3317145305:33432FE129400F2B3AEA9D0D7B350E10:r)
[_**Sponsor a Speaker for $500 >>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60856979:6hD0AsVBN:m:1:3317145305:33432FE129400F2B3AEA9D0D7B350E10:r)
[_**Sponsor a Chapter for $1,000 >>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60856980:6hD0AsVBN:m:1:3317145305:33432FE129400F2B3AEA9D0D7B350E10:r)

Friend, 50 years ago, my mother risked everything to escape Fidel Castro’s socialist regime. She left with just the clothes on her back –– and no idea where her next meal would come from. _She was penniless and homeless –– but she wasn’t hopeless!_ My mother overcame unimaginable odds to become an American because she knew freedom and the American Dream were worth sacrificing everything for. Because of her courage, I went to college... and became a prosecutor... and served in the Virginia House of Delegates... and made history by becoming Virginia’s first Latino-American Attorney General.

**It’s the greatest honor of my life to be in this position.** Last November, I promised Virginia’s parents, teachers, students, police officers, and victims of violent crime that I would do everything in my power to bring law and order back in full force. Now, I’m working every single day to deliver on those promises –– and thanks to the support of patriots like you, we’ve scored HISTORIC victories in our courthouses, cleaned up our streets, and restored faith in Virginia’s future by:
* ENDING oppressive COVID mandates.
* PROTECTING life and supporting Virginia families.
* FIGHTING woke, political indoctrination in our schools.

_Things are moving in the right direction for Virginia –– but looking at our country, I’m worried._ **The socialist, radical ideas my mother escaped in Cuba are starting to uproot our freedoms and undermine the American Dream.** Let’s be real about what’s happening. **Woke liberals who believe America was “never great” are taking desperate measures to make us conform to their way of thinking and way of life.** _In the process, they’re willing to shred our 2nd Amendment..._ _And trample all over free speech..._ _And tank our economy..._ _And teach our children to hate America..._ _And “peacefully protest” by burning small businesses..._ _And pack our Supreme Court full of political pawns..._ _And label anybody who disagrees a “domestic terrorist”...__And so much more!_ **_[Friend, I’m fighting every single day to defend freedom, the rule of law, and the American Dream because there will be nowhere left to escape if they’re lost here.](http://links.safervirginiapac.com/u/click?_t=b7c680598d5648c3aaffcf8cea32abf4&_m=9bb85aaa43a548bf90d305685fd926b0&_e=5D1NYG2jJhKxVg7TRNscyMCZrxYSvuwmRgFG7dSyE_tcgqpUg3uvJmdhziHkdkgUdcRvsn6vSUfUxxm9W4GaHAlnzcfKru1NncvuSkQu5NLApU1zUf5SdPO-VKh9Rw9xelTMj-laX8qTvTql_tDkB4C6H69k9b-Zav4oTkwwJ9DD3a-38MbjX6qBhFlFTq36LwqbbTHsQYL1p37GcSfx9CvscNOnOxmB9W0sYSMcNBeqrk-VmduuvY3SOp-nCSKL8LtgfGb4sA_8xfMHgAzKYh2aH0B959_ZAAtP8CzdeAtu1D61o0GwnrN1_DEo3BfKLbt04tn-AxXerPrRe73thg%3D%3D)_**

subject: There's no better way to celebrate National Parks and Recreation Month [PETITION]
disclaimer_text: Paid for by People for Derek Kilmer
body:
Happy National Parks and Recreation Month, Peter.
Hi Peter -

Growing up in the Olympic Peninsula, I know how important it is for our children, grandchildren, and GREAT grandchildren to have the chance to experience the beauty of our natural world the way we did.

July is National Parks and Recreation Month, which means there's no better time than now to highlight how critical our national and state parks are to our country's infrastructure. Our parks protect our natural resources, provide economic opportunity for nearby communities, and remind us of the importance and beauty of our environment.

I proudly voted _the Great American Outdoors Act_ through the House in 2020. The act permanently and fully funds the Land and Water Conservation Fund. It also provides critical funding to repair and protect our national parks. This legislation is helping create nearly 19,000 jobs while honoring our commitment to Tribal communities.

But Peter, Congress needs to continue addressing the infrastructure needs of our public lands - **both for the sake of our environment and the rural communities that are the center of our state 's outdoor recreation economy.**

**[This National Parks and Recreation Month, will you join me in urging Congress to protect our national parks and public lands? Growing up, I joined a swim team with my six siblings – _my mother wanted us out of the house!_
My love for swimming stuck with me throughout much of my childhood and into high school. It ignited a passion that I hadn’t tapped into before – competition.
Before every swim meet, we wished one another good luck because we knew that, at the end of the day, we could be proud of the winner. If one of us didn’t come out on top, there was always next time to try again.
Fast forward to being a young adult where I faced challenges as I looked to map out my future. From working through college to facing legislative battles to fund public schools in my nonprofit work, there was always another challenge that I needed to tackle.
And to this day, I still find myself in situations where I need to tap into my inner sense of competition to get the job done.
Whether it’s pushing hard for legislation that I know will better the lives of my constituents or standing up against the GOP’s heinous agenda – I’ve always been up for the challenge.
**But this competition in NV-03 is unlike any challenge I’ve faced in my life.**
I’m up against April Becker, the most extreme Republican to ever run in this district and the Republican Party is gearing up to spend millions to support her. They know that if they unseat me in November, they’ll likely take control of the House.
GOP special interests and big names like Mike Pence have already spent hundreds of thousands in television ads to spread lies about my record and misrepresent my goal, which has always been fighting for my district.
Even with so much against our campaign, I want the GOP and my opponent to know that **I’m going to continue putting up one hell of a fight to win this race.**

Whether it’s pushing hard for legislation that I know will better the lives of my constituents or standing up against the GOP’s heinous agenda – I’ve always been up for the challenge. But this competition in NV-03 is unlike any challenge I’ve faced in my life. I’m up against April Becker, the most extreme Republican to ever run in this district and the Republican Party is gearing up to spend millions to support her. They know that if they unseat me in November, they’ll likely take control of the House. GOP special interests and big names like Mike Pence have already spent hundreds of thousands in television ads to spread lies about my record and misrepresent my goal, which has always been fighting for my district. name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: A 14-cent microchip & a critical moment for Congress
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elissa Slotkin for Congress
body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220722&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220722&amount=28]
Team,
Congress currently faces a critical moment for the future of auto manufacturing in Michigan, and it all comes down to a 14-cent microchip.
The microchip shortage has been a major focus of my work in D.C. for over a year. It’s forced auto plants and parts suppliers in Michigan to open and shut assembly lines on a day-by-day basis, causing instability in our supply chain. It has upended not only our economy, but the daily lives of tens of thousands of workers who rely on these jobs to provide for their families.
You can read more about this issue in this op-ed I wrote in the Detroit News:
https://elissaforcongress.com/detnews20211014-2/ [https://elissaforcongress.com/detnews20211014-2/]
Since last year, I’ve been working with a bipartisan coalition to move the CHIPS Act – a bill that would incentivize the production of microchips by U.S. companies AND U.S. workers – through Congress. Last summer a version of it passed through the Senate as part of a larger bill and this February a larger version passed the House. Now in the final stretch, the absolute worst of Washington is preventing us from getting it over the finish line.
The Senate just voted to advance their bill earlier this week. It’s a smaller version than the original, but half a loaf is better than no loaf, and this will at least break our reliance on foreign suppliers .
This issue isn’t just going to go away. Just last week, we got word that the GM plant in Delta Township had shut down due to a lack of microchips.
Democrats. Republicans. Independents. Industry. Labor. EVERYONE understands just how critical these chips are to our economic stability and national security. This isn’t theoretical for Michigan – and we need to make our voices heard to get it done.
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220722&amount=28]
Elissa

body:
No more "ballot mixups" in Connecticut | | | _[View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/6263dbdf5164/2022-ballot_mixup?e=cd99aa018d)_
---
| | [ ](https://terriewood.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31c0ff16f808b2d717581f4dc&id=cd2e328f77&e=cd99aa018d)
---
| |
Dear Peter,

With the transition of a new interim Secretary of the State, I've been reminded of a void in leadership at the Secretary of the State's Office recently. In the 2018 election, [voters from two separate precincts in Stratford were given the wrong ballot](https://terriewood.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31c0ff16f808b2d717581f4dc&id=2b3aa1c8d6&e=cd99aa018d) and a candidate lost by only a handful of votes.

This isn't right.

Instead of being a leader and making her position clear, and putting the voices of the voters first, she stood by and let her party dictate how this situation was going to be resolved. A non-partisan election procedure became one of the most politicized and non-transparent in our state's history.

[State Senator Dennis Bradley spoke about election irregularities in 2020](https://terriewood.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31c0ff16f808b2d717581f4dc&id=a67e7abfde&e=cd99aa018d) on the Senate floor during a speech and the Secretary of the State ignored it.

This isn't right.

These dysfunctional precedents need a promise to the public to never occur again.

Then Governor Ned Lamont announced last week he was eliminating the supervised balloting in Nursing Homes due to "public health" concerns. This opens the door for a sort of elder abuse and a potential abuse in balloting. The current Secretary of the State is providing no leadership against this, no alternative to the Governor's plan.

This isn't right.

I vow to always ensure your voice is heard and your vote is counted as Secretary of the State. There is nothing more sacred than maintaining the foundation on which our country was founded. There's nothing more important than protecting your right to vote.

I will always stand up to flawed policies that put your vote in jeopardy. I will always fight to ensure free, fair, and transparent elections.

**The Republican Primary is Tuesday, August 9th,** with polls open from 6am - 8pm.

We need your help now, more than ever! We need our message to be amplified!

---
|
---
| Share this graphic with your friends on social media and encourage them to support Terrie on line 2C (or 3C if you live in the 4th Congressional District).

Warmest regards,
Terrie

clean_body: No more "ballot mixups" in Connecticut | | | | | | | Dear Peter, With the transition of a new interim Secretary of the State, I've been reminded of a void in leadership at the Secretary of the State's Office recently. In the 2018 election, and a candidate lost by only a handful of votes. This isn't right. Instead of being a leader and making her position clear, and putting the voices of the voters first, she stood by and let her party dictate how this situation was going to be resolved. A non-partisan election procedure became one of the most politicized and non-transparent in our state's history. on the Senate floor during a speech and the Secretary of the State ignored it. This isn't right. These dysfunctional precedents need a promise to the public to never occur again. Then Governor Ned Lamont announced last week he was eliminating the supervised balloting in Nursing Homes due to "public health" concerns. This opens the door for a sort of elder abuse and a potential abuse in balloting. The current Secretary of the State is providing no leadership against this, no alternative to the Governor's plan. This isn't right. I vow to always ensure your voice is heard and your vote is counted as Secretary of the State. There is nothing more sacred than maintaining the foundation on which our country was founded. There's nothing more important than protecting your right to vote. I will always stand up to flawed policies that put your vote in jeopardy. I will always fight to ensure free, fair, and transparent elections. The Republican Primary is Tuesday, August 9th, with polls open from 6am - 8pm. We need your help now, more than ever! We need our message to be amplified! | | Share this graphic with your friends on social media and encourage them to support Terrie on line 2C (or 3C if you live in the 4th Congressional District). Warmest regards, Terrie | | | | | | | | | | | | | Copyright © 2022 Terrie Wood, All rights reserved._

**\- Candidate Spotlight: Jessica McClellan, Candidate for State Treasurer -** _Each week, the Indiana Democratic Party will shine a light on one of its statewide candidates for the upcoming fall elections. _ **** Jessica McClellan is serving her second term as Treasurer of Monroe County, the 12th largest Indiana county with the 11th largest county budget. While in office, she oversees the investment of over $100 million in public funds and has increased interest income to the county by diversifying investments. Jessica has the experience to bring a balance of power to the oversight of our public funds and stretch the value of our healthy cash reserves to aid the needs of urban and rural communities. **That’s why she’s running to be Indiana’s next State Treasurer.** **Folks, we need to restore the value of our tax dollars.** Hoosiers should trust the money they send to the state is being used to deliver a better future for their families and communities — _not for partisan games. _ Indiana deserves an elected official who has the experience and vision to use our tax dollars for a better future, not a partisan one. **Hoosiers deserve to have a leader who always remembers working families — not special interests.** [With your support](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48186289/357247595/1195586897?refcode=idp-em-220721-FFF&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNjgyYWM5OS1lYzA5LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BZSZolIWVBS3Yj2LBOJ7Z2l8hMaJGoVWVEiN9wJJUD8=), we can elect Jessica McClellan and other Democrats across the Hoosier state this November. **\- INDems: Indiana GOP Putting Extremist Agenda on Abortions Ahead of Fixing State’s F-Rated Quality of Life Rating - ** This week, Democrats slammed Indiana Republican Party formally announced their plans to pursue their extreme agenda to ban access to legal and safe abortions across the state: _“Governor Eric Holcomb and the Indiana Republican Party have proven throughout this entire process (so far) that their extremist agenda to ban abortion access comes before the economic future of Hoosier families. They have delayed sending families relief checks on three occasions to help them combat global inflation and have failed to produce any legitimate plans to solve the state’s[F-rated quality of life rating](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48186290/357247596/-82093755?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNjgyYWM5OS1lYzA5LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BZSZolIWVBS3Yj2LBOJ7Z2l8hMaJGoVWVEiN9wJJUD8=&emci=a8c2b62c-e209-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=a682ac99-ec09-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=4925535) earned under the Indiana GOP’s 18-year control._ _Hoosiers will now bear witness to a special session where the Indiana GOP will use taxpayer dollars to force women and children to give birth and take away their American-right to make their own health care decisions. A politician has no business being in an exam room with a person and their doctor, and this proposal is no doubt a violation of privacy. Indiana Republicans’[own polling reveals](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48186291/357247597/1074349367?eType=EmailBlastContent&eId=1587f191-0e3c-4603-bcb4-ca657ad41bb6&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNjgyYWM5OS1lYzA5LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BZSZolIWVBS3Yj2LBOJ7Z2l8hMaJGoVWVEiN9wJJUD8=&emci=a8c2b62c-e209-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=a682ac99-ec09-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=4925535) Hoosiers do not want them to pass extremist proposals, and if they shove this regressive legislation through the statehouse, Republicans will once again ignore the will of voters and endanger women and girls’ lives in the process.”_ **\- said Mike Schmuhl, Chairman of the Indiana Democratic Party.**

When someone shows you who they are, believe them. And the Indiana GOP tells us they are an extremist party not looking after our future.
