([**If you don't need an explanation, you can donate here.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48186541/357248591/1460579386?refcode=EM_FR_220722WK_N_SM_FULL_9_NG_N_L1&fn=&ln=&em=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&add1=&ci=Cresco&st=PA&pc=18326&oc=&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDAzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0OGFkN2JhZS1lZDA5LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9sllj4vL4g7zIJc3Ln62ZXqL0poBnnk84p3FG01K0rs=) Otherwise, please read on!)

Let's start by being frank: for a long time, Democrats have not paid enough attention to down ballot races. And we've paid a price for that.

Republicans have managed to build up state legislative majorities and elect Attorneys General across the country who have worked to shape and enforce regressive laws. **In the wake of Roe v. Wade being overturned, we are seeing just how critical the long-term impact of state and local elections can be.**

Jen has always understood the importance of the down ballot. She first ran for the State Senate in 2017, flipping a Republican seat and ending the Georgia GOP's supermajority in the chamber. Now, she's running for Attorney General because the office will have a profound impact on Georgians' rights.

There are inherent challenges in running for down ballot offices like Attorney General. They don't often get the media coverage of Governor, Senate, or even House races. And because of that, many voters aren't fully aware of all the ways that an Attorney General can affect their lives.

**>From the first day of this campaign, Jen has resolved to reach as many people as possible, and raise awareness of just how important the office of Attorney General is for protecting our rights and creating accountability.**

In recent weeks, it's clear that the rollback of abortion rights — and the possibility that marriage equality and access to contraception could be reversed next — is spurring folks to take a closer look at the officeholders who enforce state laws.

**This will be an Attorney General race like none other, and we're building a campaign that's equipped to handle the high-profile attention. But we can't do it alone.**

[**Please, can you make a donation of $10 or more? Grassroots support is essential for maintaining our field outreach and building up our ads budget for the next stretch of this election. clean_body: Running for down ballot offices like Attorney General comes with inherent challenges. = In a minute, we're going to ask you to make a $10 contribution to Jen's campaign. (= Otherwise, please read on!) Let's start by being frank: for a long time, Democrats have not paid enough attention to down ballot races. And we've paid a price for that. Republicans have managed to build up state legislative majorities and elect Attorneys General across the country who have worked to shape and enforce regressive laws. In the wake of Roe v. Wade being overturned, we are seeing just how critical the long-term impact of state and local elections can be. Jen has always understood the importance of the down ballot. She first ran for the State Senate in 2017, flipping a Republican seat and ending the Georgia GOP's supermajority in the chamber. Now, she's running for Attorney General because the office will have a profound impact on Georgians' rights. There are inherent challenges in running for down ballot offices like Attorney General. They don't often get the media coverage of Governor, Senate, or even House races. And because of that, many voters aren't fully aware of all the ways that an Attorney General can affect their lives. From the first day of this campaign, Jen has resolved to reach as many people as possible, and raise awareness of just how important the office of Attorney General is for protecting our rights and creating accountability. In recent weeks, it's clear that the rollback of abortion rights — and the possibility that marriage equality and access to contraception could be reversed next — is spurring folks to take a closer look at the officeholders who enforce state laws. This will be an Attorney General race like none other, and we're building a campaign that's equipped to handle the high-profile attention. But we can't do it alone. = **= Thank you, The team at Jen Jordan for AG | | | Democratic State Senator Jen Jordan (pronounced Jer-Dun) has spent her legal career fighting for Georgians. clean_body: | | Friend, I just attended a pro-choice rally at Florida Gulf Coast University here in Southwest Florida. This rally was especially important for our movement. Young people must get involved to fight for causes that inspire them The Dobbs decision is an especially dark chapter in American history, and it’s important we fight back against it. Most Americans believe in medical privacy and women’s rights, but a small and powerful minority is taking control. Our freedom and democracy are under attack. **** I guarantee that I will do everything possible to protect abortion rights. After the Dobbs decision, I was arrested protesting at the Supreme Court because I couldn’t let them get away with taking our rights. I know how important it is to protect women’s rights during these difficult times. | After the Dobbs decision, we can’t rely on court rulings to protect us. We have no choice but to codify abortion protections into law. The midterm elections are now more important than ever before. We need to hold onto and increase our majority in Congress. It’s clear that legislation is going to be the only way forward for positive change. In Washington, my first priority will be to codify federal abortion protections. I'm not going to let the GOP take our freedoms. My opponent, Byron Donalds,. While we lost the ability to control our own health decisions, Byron cheered. Let’s throw him out of office. I’ll fight for access to abortion in Congress. body:
Hey! This week he took to social media to mislead the public . Either he doesn’t understand the issue, or he’s intentionally misleading the us for his own gain. This is a very serious problem. We deserve better. How easy, to sling blame and offer no solutions. We all know it’s painful, but we will make it through it, but this isn't helpful.

Either Jack Bergman doesn’t understand the basic economics of inflation, or he’s intentionally misleading the public for political gain. Both are beneath the dignity of his office.

Times are tough for many in the district. If you can afford it, will you contribute today to Dr. Bob Lorinser’s run for Congress so he can advance real economic solutions for hard-working Americans?

CONTRIBUTE AT bit.ly/FundDrBob

WASHINGTON, D.C. — Serious problems require serious solutions, and we need a leader at the helm who is more focused on solving problems than toeing the party line or exacerbating the divide. This week Rep. Jack Bergman took to social media to mislead the public about the causes of worldwide inflation.

Bergman’s Post:

“Record grocery and gas prices,” he said. “Highest illegal border crossings in history. Skyrocketing inflation. The Democrat-led Congress and President are derelict in their duty to the American people.”

Dr. Bob’s Post:

This is a very serious problem. Rising costs of goods and services are especially difficult for rural America and hard-working, middle-class families. However, if we hope to combat inflation, we need to understand it. So, let’s look at the facts.

The U.S. has experienced eight inflation spikes since 1940 greater than 6%, five of which were related to oil.

America addressed the problems and recovered each time. We will again. We all know it’s painful, but we will make it through it. My opponent frequently states it’s “Biden’s inflation.” The current issue is a worldwide economic phenomenon. It is our inflation. Energy, food, and housing are the major concerns for all of us.

USA - 9 - 10%, Compared Worldwide

What is causing inflation?

Inflation has multiple causes; many are linked to the pandemic.

Consumers have been flush with cash. Savings from government stimulus programs — programs passed and championed by both Republicans and Democrats for the past several years.

When the economy opened back up, it inevitably got overstimulated. Labor shortages and changing priorities of the workforce resulted in higher wages and labor costs.

Persistent supply-chain disruptions and transportation issues created costly delays and a rise in the cost of goods. This is basic supply and demand.

Russia's invasion of Ukraine significantly affects food and energy prices.

China's ongoing economic shutdown is a significant contributor.

Inexpensive borrowing and greed also play factors. Price gouging is real, and corporations are making record profits at the expense of the consumer.

The unfortunate cumulative result is higher inflation. My simple summary of the current USA situation:

2% - Baseline natural, expected economic growth

2% - COVID-related disruption

1-2% - Monetary overstimulation related to the pandemic from the current and previous administration's efforts to address COVID-19

1-2% - Russia's invasion of Ukraine

1-2% - Other issues

(Avian Flu, African Swine Fever, food disruptions, extreme weather events)

What can be done?

My opponent wants to blame someone and disregards the facts, offering no meaningful solutions. Unacceptable.

Combating inflation and advocating for economic growth requires leadership and compromise from both sides. The American people deserve better than for us to make this a partisan problem.

We must define the problem, obtain the facts, look for solutions, and act. Work together and be honest. Nothing will be quick and easy, and we must manage our expectations. Pointing fingers and playing a blame game diverts energy and resources away from real solutions.

Experts have developed various effective measures to combat the problem, and it's time to look at different approaches to problem-solving and truth-telling. To start, addressing the root causes of inflation will mitigate its effects.

Either Jack Bergman doesn't understand the basic economics of the situation, or he's intentionally misleading the public for political gain. Both are beneath the dignity of his office.

Bergman’s Post: “Record grocery and gas prices,” he said. “Highest illegal border crossings in history. Skyrocketing inflation. The Democrat-led Congress and President are derelict in their duty to the American people.” Dr. Bob’s Post: This is a very serious problem. Rising costs of goods and services are especially difficult for rural America and hard-working, middle-class families. However, if we hope to combat inflation, we need to understand it. So, let’s look at the facts. The U.S. has experienced eight inflation spikes since 1940 greater than 6%, five of which were related to oil. America addressed the problems and recovered each time. We will again. We all know it’s painful, but we will make it through it. My opponent frequently states it’s “Biden’s inflation.” The current issue is a worldwide economic phenomenon. It is our inflation. Energy, food, and housing are the major concerns for all of us. USA - 9 - 10%, Compared Worldwide What is causing inflation? Inflation has multiple causes; many are linked to the pandemic. Consumers have been flush with cash. Savings from government stimulus programs — programs passed and championed by both Republicans and Democrats for the past several years. When the economy opened back up, it inevitably got overstimulated. Labor shortages and changing priorities of the workforce resulted in higher wages and labor costs. Persistent supply-chain disruptions and transportation issues created costly delays and a rise in the cost of goods. This is basic supply and demand. Russia's invasion of Ukraine significantly affects food and energy prices. China's ongoing economic shutdown is a significant contributor. Inexpensive borrowing and greed also play factors. Price gouging is real, and corporations are making record profits at the expense of the consumer. The unfortunate cumulative result is higher inflation. My simple summary of the current USA situation: 2% - Baseline natural, expected economic growth 2% - COVID-related disruption 1-2% - Monetary overstimulation related to the pandemic from the current and previous administration's efforts to address COVID-19 1-2% - Russia's invasion of Ukraine 1-2% - Other issues (Avian Flu, African Swine Fever, food disruptions, extreme weather events) What can be done? My opponent wants to blame someone and disregards the facts, offering no meaningful solutions. Unacceptable. Combating inflation and advocating for economic growth requires leadership and compromise from both sides. The American people deserve better than for us to make this a partisan problem. We must define the problem, obtain the facts, look for solutions, and act. Work together and be honest. Nothing will be quick and easy, and we must manage our expectations. Pointing fingers and playing a blame game diverts energy and resources away from real solutions. Experts have developed various effective measures to combat the problem, and it's time to look at different approaches to problem-solving and truth-telling. To start, addressing the root causes of inflation will mitigate its effects. Either Jack Bergman doesn't understand the basic economics of the situation, or he's intentionally misleading the public for political gain. Both are beneath the dignity of his office.

subject: President Biden: declare a national climate emergency

body:
Every day we wait to act is another day we continue to live with the devastating consequences of climate change.
#

This week, Alex joined Senators Jeff Merkley, Bernie Sanders, and 5 other Senate colleagues in calling on President Biden to declare a national climate emergency.
The climate crisis is a threat unlike anything we’ve ever faced — it demands ambitious and urgent action.
We cannot wait for Republicans to accept this reality and act rationally — which is why Alex is calling on President Biden to declare a national emergency and take action to save our planet before it’s too late.
[**Can you please stand with Alex and call on President Biden to declare a national climate emergency?**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/signup/climate-emergency-em-July22/?source=em220722-1-subs&refcode2=903.159979.B1O06o&akid=903%2E159979%2EB1O06o)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.alex-padilla.com/signup/climate-emergency-em-July22/?source=em220722-1-subs&refcode2=903.159979.B1O06o&akid=903%2E159979%2EB1O06o)**
The truth is, every day we wait to act is another day we continue to live with the devastating consequences of climate change. More frequent and severe storms, deadly heat waves, rampaging wildfires here in California... this is all happening right now, not in some far-off future. And it will only get worse unless we act.
Here is the truth: In order to protect our people from natural disasters and keep our air and water clean, we need President Biden to declare a national climate emergency — _there is simply no other option right now._

Dear Fellow Conservative, Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office, and I’m sure you’ve felt the pinch at the pump just like the rest of your fellow Americans. There’s no doubt in my mind that our nation’s citizens are in need of relief. But instead, President Biden has throttled U.S. energy production. And he has trapped much of our nation’s vast energy reserves behind a wall of bureaucratic red tape. That’s why I’m sending you this email today. I’d like to hear how the Biden administration’s energy policies have affected you and your family. [**Would you be willing to share your thoughts in this brief 8 question survey?**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zk1cr3jfov8lqhfhaf1259f98btunahm6q1s7oco_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sli66ob4cth2bs) By doing so, you will help The Heritage Foundation understand what people like you think—and use your answers to fight back against the Biden administration’s radical anti-energy agenda. name: Candace Owens, Co-founder of BLEXIT
subject: How my grandfather taught me to never be a victim
body:
I want to see Black communities that are patriotic, entrepreneurial, and spiritual. This is NOT what the mainstream media and BL
[View this message in your browser](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zgmblg3eql24heb2gsh97tm98ap8kgksgtfo7ie8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sli66ob2cdh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpqcdtjmpqj4srk65qb6t9j6toj79hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4oni6hg68d30mioe2dtlcer39cri65ge4djhedpb6sb0ephm4stks3gr4pdme4pmeduie1p68dhgm9j74t1hepge1d3563gbacb4spj6ccdn6kq30tj6coqm1cr3cuobapbi4no)
[](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z65gd567v7p94h1260ated70jkosimq7df0bd0gg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sli66ob2cdh2bs)

Friend,

I'm disgusted by the biased media narrative about Black people being victims of systemic racism in 2022. This is after we elected a Black president and despite all the evidence of successful Black individuals in mainstream culture.

So why is there a perpetual narrative of Black victimhood?

**Because it is through fear and manipulation the media and organizations like BLM control Black communities. By keeping Black communities as victims, it allows BLM and others to exploit and keep their power over them. **

I too once believed this narrative. But something deep down told me to rethink everything I've been told. It was my grandfather who broke their narrative in a powerful way.

Now before I tell you the story, I want to introduce you to the BLEXIT Foundation.

I co-founded BLEXIT in 2019 in order to break the victimhood mentality in Black and urban communities. I see our communities being exploited by fear and victimhood in order to get them dependent on the government, which in turn breaks up the family, and ultimately, perpetuates the cycle of poverty.

**If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.**

What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us.

[_**Please help me shatter the victimhood mentality by donating $250, $100, $35, or any amount towards the BLEXIT Foundation. Give today by clicking here.**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zdcaq70lak0ivgfs1v6203ki80onbndi2p4893a0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sli66ob2cdh2bs)

**Story: How my grandfather taught me to never be a victim.**

My grandfather raised me. I didn't come from a perfect home. My parents split up. And what I enjoyed most about my grandfather were his stories.

He grew up during the Jim Crow era and real racism, not this fake racism CNN finds on the internet or lies about.

But there's one story he told I will NEVER forget.

As a boy, he worked on the family's share crop farm. Each morning he would wake up at 4am to lay out the tobacco to dry. Despite their difficult circumstances, they stayed together as a family and persevered.

**Then one night the KKK showed up. My grandfather woke up to bullets being shot into his home. He and his siblings hid underneath their beds.**

And then a smirk came across my grandfather's face "my father got his shotgun and fired back at them boys!"

The way he said it was with so much pride. And what I can't fathom is how in the face of this real danger, my grandfather was proud of his father for fighting back and not giving up.

Can you imagine if we all had this type of attitude?! Not letting circumstances hold us back. Not being a perpetual victim. Nowadays, people need days off work because a comedian told a joke that they don't like!

It was through my grandfather's example that I learned not to ever be a victim.

He eventually bought the same share crop farm his father worked on and started his own farm. He was financially successful, loved his wife, children, and grandchildren for his entire life.

While not everyone can have an individual like my grandfather in their lives, through BLEXIT we are going into Black and urban communities to empower people.

And it's working... _Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with 42 grassroots chapter programs in 42 states, over 15,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters._

[_**Friend, I am personally inviting you to support BLEXIT and spread our message of faith, freedom, and family to Black and urban communities. I am looking to raise $30,000 in the next 48 hours to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $1,000, $250, $100, $35, or $10 >>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2znd0266tft0bb94vlhaj02bir069j31s5iaek7j8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sli66ob2cdh2bs)

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zij34bkaqtknl66n6pfh9fjtf0sda52qk31gvq9o_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sli66ob2cdh2bs)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zn35jsockplmeal53bckofiuip3k4na4qihk0gsg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sli66ob2cdh2bs)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z4v3gj766apu2ks88nkhe6kpqv3mh35onblk61d8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sli66ob2cdh2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zgjer0e3dkem3mg4lq7u7mjjt0149qs8hkv8ud3o_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sli66ob2cdh2bs)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z095g8bfms34t5pugh650a8fsmfblq59dmtkj0gg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sli66ob2cdh2bs)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zdrpgp07o8khprdm3j2vpcjq8ojrci0aj5sj5rug_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sli66ob2cdh2bs)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z9djok4catdq2203vn58reenuumpv419kmt9ciug_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sli66ob2cdh2bs)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zaqaba313gj92r13jn0ff74ogf2q92qkugmrvkeo_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sli66ob2cdh2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zlnsbaisoqa0850kvbj7uiqbaf4jaav4tp9vugao_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sli66ob2cdh2bs)

**Here 's how BLEXIT is making a difference:**

BLEXIT enters neighborhoods no one is bothering to help - Detroit, Baltimore, Houston, New Orleans, and many other cities. We are a "do tank", not a think tank. We're providing leadership, education, training, events, and activism to break the grip of victimhood mentality.

I want to see Black communities that are patriotic, entrepreneurial, and spiritual. This is NOT what the mainstream media and BLM want to see.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zsfcs8ei7l7krb095g6psg9rtc3e2n8s0rdatj1g_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sli66ob2cdh2bs)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2ze2dkueh3a8e1tv54t3ceav5n8k1md1kh2r0eue0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sli66ob2cdh2bs)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zvm2nom1vuhr1tu8dde5goohih643b5h61s18v3o_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sli66ob2cdh2bs)

* **Teaching History:** Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z70htnusr692c48kn554drg7u0b5sbbu2fctg7hg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sli66ob2cdh2bs)

* **Presenting Our Message:** We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. [_**Please support BLEXIT 's events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zfnb32lnogpa89lfdqk8dj523v2akt30j4etmoqg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sli66ob2cdh2bs)

The biggest enemy to the media's and BLM's narrative is an intact family. That's why everything we promote comes down to being pro-family, pro-freedom, and pro-faith.

I believe we're going to change society in a fundamental way. Either BLM and the victimhood mentality wins and we all become slaves to the government or we shatter their narrative and bring about a culture of freedom.

Thank you,

Candace Owens
President
BLEXIT Foundation

_BLEXIT is a 501(c)3 tax-exempt organization. All contributions are tax-deductible to the extent provided by law._

BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message. Entrepreneurship: I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire. BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. Presenting Our Message:** We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore. The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. The biggest enemy to the media's and BLM's narrative is an intact family. That's why everything we promote comes down to being pro-family, pro-freedom, and pro-faith. I believe we're going to change society in a fundamental way. Either BLM and the victimhood mentality wins and we all become slaves to the government or we shatter their narrative and bring about a culture of freedom. Thank you, Candace Owens President BLEXIT Foundation BLEXIT is a 501(c)3 tax-exempt organization. All contributions are tax-deductible to the extent provided by law. subject: Take the National Survey on Socialism
body:
A few years ago, New York magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?”
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z607h3i9uv8cmo505i28uer26vug0n6nvagg8kmo_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37c9l6cqj7djl6eqjetjjkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbor6c3ksjhj8shgm8preobnmpim9p70m5o69p5he8pmfcdgmkqead1jc3gr1c9gsv970sj2cpob4pjgsipm6o3i61j73d5jchjr5cb66aob4pj0s2qm6o70mkoj3d9hmlp238h1e8he4933clgeap30s9i69oh5u)
| | | This sponsored message from American Defense News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zms8e1bde681irnoqmu56s3dogm6grpo3ccleov0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sli61oj4cjh2bs)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York_ magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a “Great Reset” of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ —Hillsdale College’s digest of liberty—author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as “‘capitalism with Chinese characteristics’—a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below.” Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for—and opposition to—socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z30jgpf4vp0q0q0g99be3tu1bkmqrjrbilegjvlg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sli61oj4cjh2bs)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages.** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left’s “long march through the institutions”—including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory—which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race—are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale’s work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That’s why I need your thoughts quickly.** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism** in the next five days**,** your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, “Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy.” If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today. **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z3a7davr0ghl8jjuocqagjcmo83mpnmk2rlf1ieo_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sli61oj4cjh2bs)** Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember—**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

body:
I’d like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zr7uddplpi4d7rg47128kfqc33qnn759hsl73fq0_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jksrr0s3iekr79c9l6eon9d1hmej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hfcdjgmsqrbdhnchin8t5jcpjb2sj0mep74p1imphj8d5l6gq7ashheqrb8olgc1jt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6coored9k61r60pjhe2pm6ptgmlin48d245p25oh4cdim1pb4c3jm4or24no)

| | | Friend,

I'd like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. I know I've been emailing, texting, and calling more than normal right now, but I need to reach my goal by midnight and need you to listen to me.

I hope you know me to be an honest man of integrity, so I thought I'd take a second to walk you through why I'm running for office and why this deadline means so much.

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zuob2fdg6pvtq1e3hu1rbp93ic6ilukrn0a0scv0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sli61pr2cdh2bs)
---

This is a photo of my dad (of course wearing a Miami Dolphins shirt). He was the best role model for being a father, a friend, and an American.

He and my mom thankfully came to America before the murderous dictator Fidel Castro came to power and turned Cuba to a dangerous socialist wasteland. After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream.

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zuklc1j7g0ircqstrmanbh6c0u99ceqlt695q10o_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sli61pr2cdh2bs)
---

Eventually, my sister and I became first generation college graduates, and while we had to take on student loans to do so, we knew the work ethic our parents instilled would help us pay them down once we graduated.

I met my wife Jeanette through mutual friends and we got married in 1998. We started our beautiful family of four kids: Amanda, Daniella, Anthony, and Dominick. We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...).

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2znsn6ot8isa9s44ntalcljnjdpkb1617bbp8prso_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sli61pr2cdh2bs)
---

All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted.

I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden's policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that's exactly what I did.

My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I'm teaching my kids exactly what he taught me.

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zeibm0bar66e9fnkfcot0adpshospfto2u4k5nvg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sli61pr2cdh2bs)
---

After seeing the dysfunction in Washington firsthand, I decided to run for President so I could bring my passion for America to the White House. My loving family was right by my side, and I couldn't have been more grateful for their support.

I wanted to stop Hillary Clinton at all costs, and eventually, that meant dropping out of the race and working with Donald Trump to win. Throughout his term, we worked on pro-family and pro-veteran bills to make America great and restore the American Dream.

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zrfncc7nu1hpor1j7etar0sei07hh7r0lmrhpoa8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sli61pr2cdh2bs)
---

This brings me to my main point: I'm running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to restore the American Dream.

I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from.

Reaching these deadlines may seem like a fundraising ploy, but this is real. **If we 're outraised again, that will be a major step back in our fight to restore the American Dream.**
**[I hope you'll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z3to9dqquq8jf6ft0h99k2h5u1jeqrgp02qqpkcg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sli61pr2cdh2bs)**

Thank you so much for taking the time to read this,

Marco Rubio

Well, let me tell you, this race will be decided on a razor-thin margin. Currently, we're only separated by 2%, but considering the MILLIONS my opponent is raising, she could easily take the lead after smearing me in new campaign ads.

He and my mom thankfully came to America before the murderous dictator Fidel Castro came to power and turned Cuba to a dangerous socialist wasteland. After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream. | Eventually, my sister and I became first generation college graduates, and while we had to take on student loans to do so, we knew the work ethic our parents instilled would help us pay them down once we graduated. I met my wife Jeanette through mutual friends and we got married in 1998. We started our beautiful family of four kids: Amanda, Daniella, Anthony, and Dominick. We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...). | All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted. I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden's policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that's exactly what I did. My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I'm teaching my kids exactly what he taught me. | After seeing the dysfunction in Washington firsthand, I decided to run for President so I could bring my passion for America to the White House. My loving family was right by my side, and I couldn't have been more grateful for their support. I wanted to stop Hillary Clinton at all costs, and eventually, that meant dropping out of the race and working with Donald Trump to win. Throughout his term, we worked on pro-family and pro-veteran bills to make America great and restore the American Dream. | This brings me to my main point: I'm running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to restore the American Dream. I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from. Reaching these deadlines may seem like a fundraising ploy, but this is real. If we 're outraised again, that will be a major step back in our fight to restore the American Dream. | | | Thank you so much for taking the time to read this, Marco Rubio | | | | | | I talk to folks every day who say they haven't donated because they think they need to write a big check or they think my race isn't close. Well, let me tell you, this race will be decided on a razor-thin margin. Currently, we're only separated by 2%, but considering the MILLIONS my opponent is raising, she could easily take the lead after smearing me in new campaign ads. With such a tight race, any amount donated today can make a difference. ** | | | | | Paid for by Marco Rubio for Senate PO Box 530650 Miami, FL 33153 If dpwillis67@gmail.com should not be subscribed or if you need to change your subscription information for GOP Presidential, . 625 First Street #183, Alexandria, VA 22314

clean_body: The National GOP is targeting Colorado and my seat. | = = It’s important you see this headline: = At a high-dollar Capitol Hill fundraiser this week, Mitch McConnell endorsed my self-funding opponent and pledged to spend whatever it takes to flip my seat. | “I just want to assure everybody, we’re going to be all-in in Colorado.” — Mitch McConnell Mitch called my opponent his “perfect candidate,” folks. He might be the perfect candidate for McConnell, who could push a nationwide abortion ban. He might even be the perfect candidate for Senator Rick Scott — another event attendee and chair of the GOP Senate campaign arm — who has plans to increase taxes on seniors and low-income families. But he’s not the perfect candidate for Coloradans. My opponent favors restricting reproductive rights and opposes common-sense gun legislation. He wants to waste taxpayer dollars on completing Trump’s wall, and he suggested cutting funding for Medicare and Social Security. I lowered taxes for families, banned surprise emergency medical bills, will hold Big Oil accountable for prices at the pump, and am fighting to protect reproductive choice nationwide. Mitch McConnell, Rick Scott, and the National GOP have a $200 million war chest to flip seats like mine and they’re already funneling money to help “perfect candidates” like my opponent. I don’t take a single cent from corporate PACS or federal lobbyists because I’m accountable to Colorado’s families, not corporate special interests. We’re up against the National GOP fundraising machine and an opponent dipping into his personal funds because grassroots enthusiasm for his campaign wasn’t cutting it. So I’m personally asking: Will you pitch in $10 today to defend Colorado from Mitch McConnell and the National GOP? | | | Millions of senior citizens rely on their Social Security benefits to pay their bills – and with rising costs of housing, healthcare, and more, inflation is now running ahead of standard Social Security increases. So it’s no surprise that a recent poll found that 83% of voters support raising Social Security benefits to match the rising cost of living. But Republicans are dead-set on gutting Social Security benefits (we’re not kidding – Google “Rick Scott gut Social Security”). We can’t allow seniors who have worked and paid into Social Security for their entire lives fall into financial ruin – we must demand Congress act now. [Add your name to tell Congress to protect Social Security benefits from rising inflation >>](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td02d75fe-a8e2-42d6-8025-93ad237f03cd/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

body:

Over the past few months, the extremism of the political Left's
agenda has become clear through the actions of the mainstream
media and Big Tech companies like Twitter and Amazon. Together,
these forces are working to suppress conservative speech and
political activity, denying First Amendment rights to their
political opponents-and denying access to conservative opinion
and important news stories to the American people.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWolVJbhZN

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear Fellow American,

Over the past few months, the extremism of
the political Left's agenda has become clear through the actions
of the mainstream media and Big Tech companies like Twitter and
Amazon.

Together, these forces are working to
suppress conservative speech and political activity, denying
First Amendment rights to their political opponents-and denying
access to conservative opinion and important news stories to the
American people.

Conservatives (including the former President
of the United States) are increasingly being "de-platformed" by
companies like Twitter.

Amazon is refusing to sell books questioning
the transgender revolution-and recently, it took down an
award-winning documentary video on the life of Supreme Court
Justice Clarence Thomas!

A major publishing company, Simon and
Schuster, recently bowed to pressure and canceled plans to
publish a book on the danger of Big Tech by U.S. Senator Josh
Hawley.

We have never seen anything like what we are
seeing today in America.

That's why I am asking you to take a
Hillsdale College NATIONAL SURVEY ON THE THREAT OF BIG TECH.

By completing this survey, you will help us
more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans on this
critical issue-information that will strengthen Hillsdale's
nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of
liberty…efforts we will continue to expand despite the
opposition of Big Tech.

Fellow American, you can complete the
NATIONAL SURVEY ON THE THREAT OF BIG TECH by using the link
below:

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/big-tech-survey

In the late 1960s, radicals who scorned
America and its founding principles began moving into our
colleges and universities. It took them several decades to cement
their dominance, but we see the fruits of their labors today: we
see it in the media, and we see it in Silicon Valley.

We also see it in professional sports, in
corporate America-much of which is now capitulating to far-Left
demands-and increasingly, we see it in K-12 education.

You and I know that liberty in America is
under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I
always tell people there is a way to fight this threat, despite
how uphill the fight may seem.

A vital part of the fight-and one in which
Hillsdale College is uniquely able to lead-is to reach and teach
additional millions of citizens with the TRUTH about America's
great heritage of liberty.

As you might know, Hillsdale College is
almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to
accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding-not even indirectly
in the form of federal or state student grants and loans.

This independence frees the College from
burdensome and corrupting government regulation. But it also
means that our work is entirely dependent on the generous support
of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of
education to liberty.

If you agree that we are now seeing an
unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you
will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous
tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing
the attached NATIONAL SURVEY ON THE THREAT OF BIG TECH, which you
can access at this secure link:

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/big-tech-survey

Thank you for your time and attention. I look
forward to receiving your completed survey, and I deeply
appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach
efforts on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since
1844

P.S. America is at a point where the
far-Left, with the help of its media and Big Tech allies, is
openly suppressing conservative speech and political activity,
denying First Amendment rights to their political opponents-and
denying access to conservative opinion and important news stories
to the American people.

Please help Hillsdale College more clearly
understand the views of mainstream Americans on this issue by
completing the NATIONAL SURVEY ON THE THREAT OF BIG TECH using
the secure link I've provided for you below:

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/big-tech-survey

Your answers will help strengthen our
educational outreach efforts that reach and teach millions of
Americans about our nation's great heritage of liberty-and about
the duty of each generation to defend liberty and pass it on to
their children and grandchildren.

Folks, Families in New Mexico and across the country are struggling to afford everyday costs. A major piece of that has been rising fossil fuel energy prices — which deliver record profits to Big Oil CEOs while families shoulder the cost. Meanwhile, the climate crisis is getting worse by the day. Our children and future generations are counting on us to act. From the wildfires and floods in New Mexico to heatwaves around the world — the crisis is here and getting worse. Fellow Senators and I have called on President Biden to declare a climate emergency. We need to lower the high costs facing families _and_ take on the climate crisis. Investing in clean energy and electrification does both. By investing in clean energy, we can stabilize and lower energy costs for good. And making electrification accessible for all families ensures that those lower costs show up in your home utility bills and daily commute. [**If you're with me and agree that we need to address climate change and rising fossil fuel energy costs at the same time, add your name:**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48190546/357267383/-1642579203?refcode=AU_MTH_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20220722_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS84OTA0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlN2VhMTc4ZC1mYjA5LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EjkXwktblsHp6pX7vqAV6l3-qO6aCjk-qVKy35GjE9o=&emci=d1ca9979-fb09-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=e7ea178d-fb09-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=252045) | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48190547/357267384/-1642579203?refcode=AU_MTH_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20220722_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS84OTA0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlN2VhMTc4ZC1mYjA5LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EjkXwktblsHp6pX7vqAV6l3-qO6aCjk-qVKy35GjE9o=&emci=d1ca9979-fb09-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=e7ea178d-fb09-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=252045)

We can and should act now to reverse the worst effects of climate change and put money back in people's pockets at the same time. That’s why I've prioritized legislation like my _Zero-Emissions Homes Act_ to make it more affordable for families to upgrade to electric appliances. I also pushed for major climate action in the bipartisan infrastructure bill — including the first-ever national electric vehicle charging network.
But we can’t stop here. Addressing climate change has to be a priority for every major piece of legislation we consider. It is so deeply embedded in our everyday lives.
We must use every tool at our disposal — from swiftly passing climate legislation to urging the Biden administration to use their power to address this growing crisis.

name: Carlina Rivera
subject: Just another “soft on choice” Democrat
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Carlina for New York
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/carlinarivera3 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/carlinarivera3]
Dear Peter,
The last few months have hit us hard. Between the leaked draft of the Dobbs v. Jackson Supreme Court decision in May to the actual decision that came down in June, the extremist, right-wing attacks on abortion are mounting.
Even before this disaster, I worked tirelessly to make abortion safe, affordable and accessible to everyone. That’s why it was so hard to see my opponent flip-flop on this critical issue – one that he clearly doesn’t understand – in an interview released this week.
As a pro-choice Latina, I am not just checking a box to win this primary. I am fighting, tooth and nail, for reproductive freedom, which Black and Latina women have been historically denied in more ways than one.
I have fought proudly for abortion and contraception access. In the New York City Council, my Women's Caucus colleagues and I spearheaded the nation’s first municipally funded abortion access fund [https://carlinarivera.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5ebb7fcc9c4e1e9fab452c873&id=5327dffd44&e=36cf3e22cb] , expanded equitable access to contraception, and defended gender-affirming and culturally humble healthcare. In fact, it's because of my record that, we made news this week when PODER PAC, which helps elect pro-choice Latina women, announced their endorsement [https://www.carlinarivera.nyc/news/poder-pac-endorses-carlina-rivera-for-congrses-in-ny-10] of my candidacy.
Plus, just last week, the City Council passed a legislative package to protect abortion rights, which included my bills to require that City-run health sites provide FDA approved abortion pills at no cost to patients and to fight back against harmful fake clinics.
Carlina Rivera speaking at a reproductive rights rally at the foot of a courthouse. Carlina is wearing a blazer and standing at a podium that reads, “The Public Advocate” above the City of New York logo. Carlina is surrounded by other advocates and elected officials carrying signs with messages supporting reproductive health rights. [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/99346/images/unnamed.jpeg]
We need someone in Washington who can deliver results and protect reproductive freedom . I will fully support executive and legislative actions to meaningfully protect abortion access, including:
✅ Ending the Hyde Amendment
✅ Declaring a public health emergency for reproductive health care access
✅ Ending the filibuster
✅ Funding abortion care
Will you ensure that New York City, and the entire country, is a safe place to access abortion care for all who seek it?
COUNT ME IN! [https://www.carlinarivera.nyc/]
!Pa’lante!
Carlina

New York, NY 10009

This will be the most important race in the entire country... |
Friend,

Will you help me FIRE Liz Cheney and take back our conservative movement from the elitist establishment that is working arm-in-arm with Joe Biden?

No sooner had President Trump endorsed my primary challenge to Liz Cheney did she shoot back with her usual arrogance to "bring it."

[**Well, I'm counting on you to help me bring it by chipping in with an emergency donation to my campaign to FIRE Liz Cheney.**](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=eb691ac85c8247ffad811a2541150255&_e=ckcDrjhdRzg1D3S2uEqT0uD2tv-J4e6tcyrZkRLHU3R0dQpD3x5ynC0A1i9yR_7zllFMudbVE_fTGnoMV_ZgIO0O0fzR3TDqLsInzVM5FawkP-8ys--GlFRlsS1S3cIl9df25Wl7aOqRWfwoNr17_TnzznB9kB_OnoVmC5_gxayWQLx6zsRizYZcqeNf7BVHgp7kOot7h0Y5CCTRapsmG0nyf-Ea_EuFhVkn9yt9Uc-t2ZG4iVoPw57L9ZYjnKaHJeFUBNVu5wryT0IjK3DuRUDLww0oPAG6vCuYnI4DSmtH2ZikAEteUXoYlG8k19B9zcbKd8jDEBdwn3OENlcVi4Ao3n2n1I1457uu9u22oSK8Npot-ehspBKgbG3uRucfPYrW8apNLFqXi-YC01JBWSzlCwdUms9d4E7racXICWcsed20FURrCA9fLyUWUFKjFBOU2CP5MLex59sWMBgghn8nu6XZ39pU5aFNOhZ3Avo%3D) [DONATE NOW](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=eb691ac85c8247ffad811a2541150255&_e=ckcDrjhdRzg1D3S2uEqT0uD2tv-J4e6tcyrZkRLHU3R0dQpD3x5ynC0A1i9yR_7zllFMudbVE_fTGnoMV_ZgIO0O0fzR3TDqLsInzVM5FawkP-8ys--GlFRlsS1S3cIl9df25Wl7aOqRWfwoNr17_TnzznB9kB_OnoVmC5_gxayWQLx6zsRizYZcqeNf7BVHgp7kOot7h0Y5CCTRapsmG0nyf-Ea_EuFhVkn9yt9Uc-t2ZG4iVoPw57L9ZYjnKaHkFExeggtZjX-FgJu8MPnQJWENXtxAfqgRpfcTAttbfRgIV3RTPifFSRfHrGUB56pT-3RQDgyjc3LW4EsFWscEVLljW53yzsha99U8XIB3oZenm8odMYkbUX54pjQ7-YRYR5yyjrblkDNmN8qemkAiGNk8XWNSFRrDCmbOmq68jVib2IlqSVxclJ3WrUdAFMrBrRwonRTMm1oaGQdWbq3jx_YhpPMrrWI5L-4-PUJCQg%3D)
You and I don't have a moment to lose...

That's because establishment elitists, like George W. Bush, headline ritzy fundraisers in other states to raise millions for Cheney.

That was even after Cheney admitted in a 60 Minutes interview that her record-breaking fundraising haul was helped out by Democrats.

If there was ever a time for conservative Americans to stand up to the elitist establishment, it's now. And it's against Liz Cheney.

[**Will you help me stand up with an urgently needed donation today?**](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=eb691ac85c8247ffad811a2541150255&_e=ckcDrjhdRzg1D3S2uEqT0uD2tv-J4e6tcyrZkRLHU3R0dQpD3x5ynC0A1i9yR_7zllFMudbVE_fTGnoMV_ZgIO0O0fzR3TDqLsInzVM5FawkP-8ys--GlFRlsS1S3cIl9df25Wl7aOqRWfwoNr17_TnzznB9kB_OnoVmC5_gxayWQLx6zsRizYZcqeNf7BVHgp7kOot7h0Y5CCTRapsmG0nyf-Ea_EuFhVkn9yt9Uc-t2ZG4iVoPw57L9ZYjnKaHEAs9TCltcrVOqDk6J6rVnOo0Miiix4fkmtUH8m7wt44TAhAY5KuO1idXIAftBa5wbNbZuuSdjTBrBfZx76BnJsH2LO_JgtvaQAMEp1eS_CFicC7rHTxiSd_PYupPYZhBY6L_bcOQJKrHP5Qn2krfmptKBqFWap_M9D4yy_ntwLjjqjJ6aS2TArNhxdYguLSITPlWsP8HqqNkM2m7c7D6-vgIJglI5Vl2ORfHSBDsu40%3D)

I'm getting ahead of myself.

Before you decide to give to my campaign to FIRE establishment-anointed Liz Cheney from Congress, **let me tell you a little about who I am, why President Trump endorsed my primary challenge, and why we need your immediate help.**

My name is Harriet Hageman, and Wyoming is my home.

Growing up on a ranch outside Ft. Laramie, I learned the value of hard work, integrity, self-sufficiency, and honesty from an early age.

They're not just values Joe Biden and his socialists hate – they run absolutely counter to the establishment elites who have for too long controlled our Republican Party... and sold out our country to the highest bidder.

**I should know – like many in my state, and many more around the country, I was duped by these same "Republicans."**

**And as a constitutional lawyer who fought against Bill Clinton's EPA regulations, I watched in disgust as establishment elites like Liz Cheney embraced big government and abandoned our conservative values.**

Unfortunately, it's only gotten worse since President Trump left office.

And now, backed by their friends on the left and the media, Cheney and the establishment are waging a full-blown war on Americans like you and me!

[**No more. Will you support my campaign to defeat Liz Cheney by making an emergency donation today? I'll be honest, her LIBERAL big money backers are putting millions of dollars into her campaign right. Without your help, I don't stand a chance.**](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=eb691ac85c8247ffad811a2541150255&_e=ckcDrjhdRzg1D3S2uEqT0uD2tv-J4e6tcyrZkRLHU3R0dQpD3x5ynC0A1i9yR_7zllFMudbVE_fTGnoMV_ZgIO0O0fzR3TDqLsInzVM5FawkP-8ys--GlFRlsS1S3cIl9df25Wl7aOqRWfwoNr17_TnzznB9kB_OnoVmC5_gxayWQLx6zsRizYZcqeNf7BVHgp7kOot7h0Y5CCTRapsmG0nyf-Ea_EuFhVkn9yt9Uc-t2ZG4iVoPw57L9ZYjnKaH4FE1SwYJ37HwNfTUhk1R1ZNk7i8isZa8I281NWz1_HRQHRIGh0LmfFpXCUC0wCRwYJNl1pex297GcHZxJZGqmlbZoLdPcr3x5BOUj3F4WWUSpzU6GX1o--5w4OJK4KvAhvqwZa3C_Se43lfo5FzhwK1qkOkqHV9zfEbbC9gjyxGWfXRymMa_LO3qSpr6TJxXIA_NxM1ZFC6DNj4mp1j34OU5EQLWi9c_cpCJx21sZTc%3D) [DONATE NOW](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=eb691ac85c8247ffad811a2541150255&_e=ckcDrjhdRzg1D3S2uEqT0uD2tv-J4e6tcyrZkRLHU3R0dQpD3x5ynC0A1i9yR_7zllFMudbVE_fTGnoMV_ZgIO0O0fzR3TDqLsInzVM5FawkP-8ys--GlFRlsS1S3cIl9df25Wl7aOqRWfwoNr17_TnzznB9kB_OnoVmC5_gxayWQLx6zsRizYZcqeNf7BVHgp7kOot7h0Y5CCTRapsmG0nyf-Ea_EuFhVkn9yt9Uc-t2ZG4iVoPw57L9ZYjnKaHcaIoenhN9vJCJeq5xggn3QkKvP3aRcgQqgcpFI6kheO0GbFzCfFi6Mr-pgpJrKzS-Mhsh0AE60MVUsyptvIxv-Wh_yKc8Ov3N2oOF_J4WTKJP_qCXK-owFzw1Xxp9OFdshWSPguW7tRjchr9SBTomufAPOcKU8FHt27fpoKEiAQXiMZFxqwBd1-A6v5j4EmwiI9P_nJYq-4iB7ESU3-qqqgyzUobn6uy5mX2cELJ0OU%3D) As I said at the start of this email, **President Trump is 100% behind me.**

He knows the people of Wyoming – and the _American_ people - deserve better than Cheney, and he knows I'll never abandon our conservative values once elected to Congress.

In Wyoming, we have a long and proud history of standing up against an overbearing government.

In Washington, I promise to do the same...

You needn’t look far to find a news piece about the increase in violent crime. I cannot tell you how many times I’ve opened the paper to read bylines like, “ _**9 murders in Chicago**_ ,” or “ _**17 murders in Philadelphia over the weekend**_.” As a Black man running as a Republican for Congress, I feel that I must speak truth to power:**OUR LEADERS HAVE FAILED US**. The far-left socialist politicians that progressive Democrats have put in charge of our country’s largest cities have only made the situation worse.

How, you might ask?
1. They’ve defunded the police in favor of spending money on mental health initiatives
2. They’ve made purchasing a firearm next to near impossible
3. They’ve stopped prosecuting miscreants who wreak HAVOC on the streets.

[**WATCH MY LAUNCH VIDEO >> **](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=79fb1aa2eeb84ce78b580df24d6816fe&_e=dciwqhSNvu97zQB2IalPv_aVDqm88I6ZsHAngsvpEc90Nj3aMleqJ-3oRvSz4CQCPWYPXSeYVu8PCMRWkumMZSg82y7nxTI8GWeOnj-SsFJsTQe3njHYP5iBlKCwczu5pJLpo-T7pguxeGn-I3VJKhOTOGQHEdRIkBV9e8Wk913O7i0AE-BEAdeFGgPq4xcZ7mz7M8gdDuw2Q77R6eqEmHlzKkTNN7AWkdBY8oC9zOSR65yFOLyFF_a529TKQxI_Y1POUKhvaugZhLWYldnvuU5DkYtNFaDYIxoHB0U-BtAw7MA7eNJ8L9qngqiL2ixhC1F6fd646yoTEnY5cRamtGh2NEyDBokXcPelneYOVjdhxYXW3vQKIbUybQjUiKbODIrGM0n1xDDzogxrtw9NPzudD7AhtP3DmvNZwBUxB_4B6ylr0enldQggn394EB6sClI047NQqvQy_EVzMxH_GA%3D%3D)
All of this has resulted in Black Americans purchasing firearms for self-protection at the highest rate in DECADES! Why? Because we're the ones most directly affected by the ineptitude (READ FAILURE) of Democrat leadership.

According to an article I recently read in the Wall Street Journal, the National Shooting Sports Foundation reports that “t**hey sold 58% more guns to black customers in the first half of 2020 than a year earlier, the highest increase for any ethnic group**.” Furthermore, 88% of these respondents purchased a gun “” f**or protection against crime**.””

Dear Friend, While many people are familiar with David as the shepherd boy who slew the giant, they likely don’t know his full story--especially the tragedies that befall his family and his beautiful turn to repentance. In fact, at its heart, the story of David is about fathers and sons.

King David’s momentous story provides profound insights into many of life’s most important questions, including: What are my responsibilities to God? What do I owe my fellow man? How do I lead my family? How do I turn away from sin? What is the best way to lead others?

Taught by Hillsdale College Professor of English Justin Jackson, **“The David Story: Shepherd, Father, King”** examines the Old Testament books of First and Second Samuel. This eight-lesson course explores David’s character and the consequences of his choices on his family and the people of Israel.
---
| | **This is why we’ve produced our online course, “The David Story: Shepherd, Father, King,” which is now available on DVD. And you can reserve your copy using this secure link:**

**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/david-story-dvd](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c38314%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Ss2r7SQ2m%2buUGVi4Vwog6g&sysid=1)** By viewing the course, you’ll learn more about the nature of God, family, leadership, sin, and repentance; in short, you’ll learn more about what truly matters in life. **I hope you’ll reserve your DVD today and share its abiding lessons with your family and friends. The DVD is perfect for a Bible study or homeschool curriculum.**

| | Dear Fellow Conservative, Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office, and I’m sure you’ve felt the pinch at the pump just like the rest of your fellow Americans. There’s no doubt in my mind that our nation’s citizens are in need of relief. But instead, President Biden has throttled U.S. energy production. And he has trapped much of our nation’s vast energy reserves behind a wall of bureaucratic red tape. That’s why I’m sending you this email today. I’d like to hear how the Biden administration’s energy policies have affected you and your family.

Peter, As a meteorologist, it was my job to communicate the weather news to Northwest Illinois, and (most importantly) to earn my viewers' trust. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48179671/357224333/-295409223?refcode=em-7.22.22-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNThhMWM5ZS1kYzA5LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=815noJ6JLMBGvM26HQJ6iuXLF0QuUl9f4RH07qLr3pc=) A big reason why I'm running for Congress is because I believe we're facing a trust and communication crisis in Washington, and nowhere is that more apparent than in how we talk about **climate change**. Oftentimes, we hear politicians frame climate change in terms that aren't tangible to everyday life -- like "saving the polar bears” or through dire warnings of global catastrophe in “20 or 30 years.” While both are true, as a meteorologist I can tell you the climate crisis is impacting our day-to-day lives _right now_. Big storms capture the public's attention, but it’s routine heat waves -- like the one we're currently in -- that are the #1 weather-related killer. For local farmers, even small temperature swings can have a devastating impact on crop yields. And if you're in a town near the river like Moline, serious heat could mean serious flooding and damage to local businesses. In Congress, it'll be my goal to frame climate change through the lens of how it impacts our daily lives. The ‘here and now’ can't be denied, and we need to paint that picture if we’re going to cut through the typical GOP rebuttals. [**I'm ready to treat climate change with the urgency it deserves. By electing me, Illinois has a golden opportunity to lead on the climate crisis, but it’s going to take a groundswell of grassroots support to do it. If you can, send in a donation to support my campaign today.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48179672/357224334/-295409223?refcode=em-7.22.22-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNThhMWM5ZS1kYzA5LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=815noJ6JLMBGvM26HQJ6iuXLF0QuUl9f4RH07qLr3pc=) | **********[Donate $5](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48179673/357224335/-295409223?refcode=em-7.22.22-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNThhMWM5ZS1kYzA5LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=815noJ6JLMBGvM26HQJ6iuXLF0QuUl9f4RH07qLr3pc=)**********

body:
Watch our new ad, titled “Universal.”
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48179992/357224674/196037868?sourceid=1071963&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDg5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1YWI1ZDFlOS1kYzA5LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8H18nnxC43qp9mslfOQzwh0XRVn8KDKN_PYwlTktL2E=&emci=f332e893-da09-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=5ab5d1e9-dc09-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=43402276) | Friends, Years ago, while serving as an Assistant Attorney General and teaching night classes at Vermont Law School to make ends meet, my mom went into the hospital and needed my help. I was working to pay my rent and student loan debt, and just barely getting by. After using up my limited sick days and vacation days, I found myself potentially confronted with an impossible decision; caring for a loved one or paying the bills. Vermonters, and especially women, are confronted with these tough decisions every day. That’s why for me, and for so many women and caregivers, the fight for paid family and medical leave isn’t theoretical, it’s personal. It’s why I ran for office. **Today, I launched a new TV ad to share this story:** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48179993/357224675/785897239?sourceid=1071963&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDg5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1YWI1ZDFlOS1kYzA5LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8H18nnxC43qp9mslfOQzwh0XRVn8KDKN_PYwlTktL2E=) Paid family and medical leave makes economic sense. Our economy, working families, and employers thrive when workers can remain employed when crisis strikes. **In Congress, I will work with anyone to pass universal paid family and medical leave so that no Vermonter or American ever has to choose between paying the bills and caring for someone they love.** Nationally, there are roughly 53 million unpaid caregivers. Over 5 million American women, including a disproportionate number of Vermont women, have left the workforce since March 2020. Paid family and medical leave would be a game-changer for thousands of working families in Vermont. **I won’t stop until paid family and medical leave is a reality for every Vermonter and every American.** Yours, _Team Molly_

clean_body: Watch our new ad, titled “Universal.” | Friends, Years ago, while serving as an Assistant Attorney General and teaching night classes at Vermont Law School to make ends meet, my mom went into the hospital and needed my help. I was working to pay my rent and student loan debt, and just barely getting by. After using up my limited sick days and vacation days, I found myself potentially confronted with an impossible decision; caring for a loved one or paying the bills. Vermonters, and especially women, are confronted with these tough decisions every day. That’s why for me, and for so many women and caregivers, the fight for paid family and medical leave isn’t theoretical, it’s personal. It’s why I ran for office. Today, I launched a new TV ad to share this story: = Paid family and medical leave makes economic sense. Our economy, working families, and employers thrive when workers can remain employed when crisis strikes. In Congress, I will work with anyone to pass universal paid family and medical leave so that no Vermonter or American ever has to choose between paying the bills and caring for someone they love. Nationally, there are roughly 53 million unpaid caregivers. Over 5 million American women, including a disproportionate number of Vermont women, have left the workforce since March 2020. Paid family and medical leave would be a game-changer for thousands of working families in Vermont. I won’t stop until paid family and medical leave is a reality for every Vermonter and every American. | PRESS RELEASE: SOUTH DAKOTA GOVERNOR KRISTI NOEM TO CAMPAIGN IN SUPPORT OF GEOFF DIEHL FOR GOVERNOR
Kristi Noem, Governor of South Dakota, will travel to Massachusetts in support of Geoff Diehl's campaign for Massachusetts Governor in August.
Governor Noem will arrive in Boston and appear alongside Diehl on the campaign trail on Wednesday, August 10. She also will attend a fundraising event for Diehl at the residence of Ernie Boch, Jr.

"He offers a unique blend of conservative credentials, trusted legislative experience, and practical work in the private sector, all of which give him a valuable perspective on how to best serve the needs of Massachusetts residents. I am proud to endorse Geoff Diehl and support his campaign for Governor."
"I am honored and humbled to have the support of Governor Noem, who is such a strong and effective leader for the people of South Dakota," Diehl said. "I thank Governor Noem for offering to come to Massachusetts and join me on the campaign trail. I especially admire her leadership during the pandemic, when she was one of the few leaders in our nation to keep her people safe and keep her state open for business. It is my sincere pleasure to welcome her to the Bay State and to show her everything we are doing to wage our campaign against high taxes and big government."
"It is my distinct honor to host Governor Noem and Geoff Diehl as guests at my home," stated Ernie Boch, Jr. "Governor Noem is one of the most exciting Governors in the country, showing true courage and leadership for the people she represents. Geoff Diehl offers the same hope and opportunity to the people of Massachusetts, and I am proud to support his candidacy."
Geoff Diehl is the Republican Party's officially-endorsed candidate for Governor of Massachusetts.

| Team, later today, Donald Trump is going to host _yet another campaign rally of this election cycle._ It’s the second time he’s come to Arizona just this year.

All week, our staff and I have been planning ways to counteract this rally and blunt the momentum he’s trying to create for his extreme candidates. We’ve talked to voters and the press about the danger of Trump and how his hand-picked candidates are too extreme for Arizona.

But once Trump lands, all the cameras will be focused on him and the lies he’s certain to tell. We need the resources to break through those lies.

body:

Dear Friend, While many people are familiar with David as the shepherd boy who slew the giant, they likely don’t know his full story--especially the tragedies that befall his family and his beautiful turn to repentance. In fact, at its heart, the story of David is about fathers and sons.

King David’s momentous story provides profound insights into many of life’s most important questions, including: What are my responsibilities to God? What do I owe my fellow man? How do I lead my family? How do I turn away from sin? What is the best way to lead others?

Taught by Hillsdale College Professor of English Justin Jackson, **“The David Story: Shepherd, Father, King”** examines the Old Testament books of First and Second Samuel. This eight-lesson course explores David’s character and the consequences of his choices on his family and the people of Israel.
---
| | **This is why we’ve produced our online course, “The David Story: Shepherd, Father, King,” which is now available on DVD. And you can reserve your copy using this secure link:**

**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/david-story-dvd](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64786%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=07%2blHJ2dMdEJl3Oc1qMTfA&sysid=1)** By viewing the course, you’ll learn more about the nature of God, family, leadership, sin, and repentance; in short, you’ll learn more about what truly matters in life. **I hope you’ll reserve your DVD today and share its abiding lessons with your family and friends. The DVD is perfect for a Bible study or homeschool curriculum.**

body:
"the most pro-life governor in Ohio history."
| Team,

For a long time, Mike DeWine was proud to advertise himself as **"the most pro-life governor in Ohio history."** But now that Ohioans have made it clear that they believe in a woman's right to choose, DeWine has publicly backtracked on his extremist promises to strip women of their rights – **and has even removed all mentions of abortions on his official website.**
| |
---
_"Until at least mid-April, DeWine’s campaign website touted him as 'the most pro-life governor in Ohio history,' highlighting his signature of the 'Heartbeat Bill' and the 'Born Alive Infant Protection Act.' By mid-July, however, the site no longer mentioned abortion at all."_
Team, we refuse to let Governor DeWine get away with trying to hide his extremist views. He does not now, nor will he ever have what it takes to fight for Ohioans. **Just because he's scrubbed his website of abortion, doesn't mean we'll forget what he's said – and done – to strip us of our fundamental rights.**

We have the power to protect reproductive rights here in Ohio. This November, Ohioans will take their outrage to the polls and defeat the extremist Republicans who gutted our freedom to choose.

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
December 2, 2020
Former 5th District Candidates Coalesce Around Luke Letlow in Runoff
Start, LA – Former candidates who ran to represent Louisiana’s 5^th Congressional District, Allen Guillory, Matt Hasty and Phillip Snowden, joined together this week to announce their endorsement of Luke Letlow in the runoff election for Louisiana’s 5th Congressional District.

The candidates represent bipartisan support from across the district backing Letlow in the runoff. After meeting personally with Letlow, the three candidates noted that it was his strong commitment to work for all of the 5th District’s citizens that made him the clear choice in the runoff.

“I'm honored by the trust that these outstanding individuals have placed in me and I’m grateful for their support. They ran great campaigns and brought good ideas to the table. Since the beginning, our message has been about rising above politics and building consensus. I look forward to working with all of the candidates who stepped up to run in this election and beyond to move the 5th District forward,” said Luke Letlow.

“I prayed on it, and we going to support Luke Letlow. We have a lot in common, both of us have two kids, are married to our high school sweethearts, and are Christians. Together we can change things in our community,” said Allen Guillory.

“Luke is somebody who believes that the philosophies that we have must be driven by core values and not by partisanship or anything else that would put elections before the people,” said Matt Hasty.

“Our next congressman must be a strong advocate for our district, Louisiana, and the country. We must work hard to move roadblocks and give our people a fighting chance. Politicians with promises and claims do not build businesses or create jobs. The hard working, tax paying residents of the district create businesses and jobs. Louisiana’s 5^th Congressional District needs someone who understands commonsense and rational thoughts to remove roadblocks. I believe Luke Letlow can better achieve this endeavor versus his opponent and is the reason I endorse him. I have casted my vote for him and believe voters should too,” said Phillip Snowden.

About Luke Letlow:

Luke Letlow is a 9th generation Louisianian from Start, Louisiana who has dedicated his life to public service and worked to protect rural Louisiana’s way of life.

A lifelong Republican, Luke has worked alongside Congressman Ralph Abraham to make sure Washington listens to real people and has Abraham’s endorsement. Luke has served as Chief of Staff to Rep. Abraham throughout Abraham’s time in Congress.

Luke is running for Congress to be a conservative voice in Washington who will get results for Louisiana, work to defeat the radical socialists, and keep the economy moving forward.

Luke attended Ouachita Christian High School and received a B.S. from Louisiana Tech University in 2003. Luke and his wife, Dr. Julia Barnhill Letlow, are raising their two young children in Start, and they worship at Covenant Presbyterian Church (EPC) in Monroe.
