body:
KeithPekau.com

https://www.keithpekau.com/
Peter,

This week, I had the honor of delivering Officer Dan Golden a birthday card from the Orland Park Community. At age 32, he was left paralyzed after being shot by three men outside a bar.
https://www.facebook.com/photo/?fbid=349272407393931&set=a.165047539149753

This was terrible news for the people of Cook County. They are less safe today, as an attack on any officer has a chilling effect on ranks of a department already struggling to fill police vacancies. The three individuals who perpetrated this attack need to face very swift and exacting justice.

The Village of Orland immediately went to work with local authorities to provide whatever support we could to help in bringing the perpetrators to justice.

I want to thank both the Chicago Police Department and the Cook County Sheriff’s Office for their response and continued efforts during this tragedy. The men and women of the Chicago Police Department and all of our Cook County officers selflessly run into harm’s way to protect the lives of others - on and off duty. Betty and I continue to pray for Officer Dan Golden and his family.

Cook County has voted overwhelmingly for far-left prosecutors and judges who put the safety of our communities at risk. We must push back in November, or this is only going to get worse.

Support Our Police.

Thank you,

Keith Pekau
Mayor of Orland Park
Republican Nominee for Illinois’ Sixth Congressional District

In Case You Missed It

Pekau Added to NRCC Young Guns List: (https://www.facebook.com/photo?fbid=452242763578561&set=a.244840540985452) The Young Guns program is divided into multiple levels containing benchmarks that a candidate must achieve to advance in the program. Candidates who achieve full Young Guns status have successfully collaborated with the NRCC and completed the requirements that establish a path to victory on Election Day. In 2020, 25 Young Guns were elected to Congress. Since its inception, the Young Guns program has helped elect over 150 members of Congress.

Calumet City Man Arrested for Possession of a Stolen Motor Vehicle Attempts to Escape Police by Fleeing Through Orland Square Mall: (https://richardfreepress.substack.com/p/calumet-city-man-arrested-for-possession?utm_medium=email&%3Butm_campaign=cta&%3Baction=share&utm_source=substack&fbclid=IwAR35SEpBck7ND9mH242MqQr8-GVrdZKWiKyuIab7T_qEgX9FD8Zor1OBrDc) "I want to thank the Orland Police Department for their solid work. They undoubtedly prevented another crime - maybe more - from being committed. This was good police work. This is what happens when lawmakers work with police departments to ensure they have proper training and the resources they need to protect and serve.

It’s why the Village of Orland Park fell to the lowest number of index crimes in 27 years, with an overall 9.2% decrease from 2020 - even as crime rose throughout Chicagoland. It is why in Orland Park violent crime also fell by 24%, with no homicide or rape incidents.

As the Mayor of Orland Park, I have seen what works.

As a resident of Cook County, I have seen what doesn’t work.

And right now, across the country Democrats want to do what doesn’t work: demoralize, dismantle and defund our police.

I am going to Congress to push back against the extremism that has seized the Democrat party, to restore safety to our streets, and to Defend Our Police."

Hey Derek, We’ve been wondering what Glenn Youngkin’s go-to in-flight movie choices are as flies around the country prepping his presidential bid. _“Gone with the Wind?”_ Perhaps _“Gone in 60 Seconds?”_ One thing we do know: Glenn Youngkin is _G-O-N-E._ So, where has he been?
* Glenn Youngkin’s wanderlust has taken him to **New York** , to meet with Republican megadonors as he fills his warchest for his bid for the presidency.
* The next week, Glenn Youngkin flew to **Nebraska** to headline their GOP convention, seeking support for his potential candidacy in the Cornhusker State.
* Then, on Monday, Glenn Youngkin showed up again – not in Virginia, but **Colorado** , this time to test his political fortune in the Rockies.

Governors of both parties often take political trips in office; what makes Glenn Youngkin’s journeys so alarming is the fact that they’ve been kept secret from the Virginians he took an oath to serve. Now, we can’t say we’re surprised that this governor has been doing so much jetsetting, but we’re used to governors traveling on behalf of the Commonwealth, not their own political ambition. We expect more from our leaders here in Virginia. Derek,

I'm sure many of you have looked on in horror this week, as I have, at the
unprecedented, hellish heat wave sweeping across the United States and
Europe. Airport runways are melting, train tracks are buckling, and acre
upon acre of forest is being consumed beneath raging wildfires the likes
of which we know all too well in California.

The United States’ leadership during this global energy and climate crisis
is essential. Putin's homicidal war of aggression on Ukraine has squeezed
Europe's supply of fossil fuels, and a pivot to renewable energy would
both undercut Putin’s war economy and help save our planet. And all
Republican Senators and one Democrat are standing in the way of action.

Our climate is tipping our planet towards a point of no return, swept up
in a vicious cycle of accelerating extreme weather effects. And despite
legislation House Democrats have passed to invest hundreds of billions of

name: Defend the Constitution
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7aa634d6a07c43a69a89283a3e992604&_e=IKWjfp9RtLnb2VmMxFo8LIjYCXdhoxlpZzZLDr_CrxvZ8nZzne3mH9CCFb3hfcQz7ZhVWlMbnHxphdMiEDbFFEC1vlV5YI-_M0I2IMU1N30kVe0VNue1drjFHcuRKzSjazG7oTEHaMILqWzd6fj_S-N6-cTKWxNYiH3iyFJCUQ6UJJ1AQ4Ne3XFPdg3hKhohlCbMSIlJ4pUPnw-UQ3mr1tDQ9_29IEopcmssB8V0lKMDBZNGpaHnirEV3wz8Y30vtOrRNxr66XB5PqnxOBldcZDSe6x82yA6rGwYrOYxIkV4EfMhtmqfyDMHKf-pv_G5HTewgJeyzXBMqZG9n_TQzp4G_YEjY4aASMNT1fWDT5tcYgy2bgGB1ddnCxfvfDXlpx2V0kvw3xbAZcZ-hz8OfUTdZTB6W03RasYihOR1ed4tTap3ivVyfv1U50-IWG7T7bqwXPpb4qaFJjkOGGnXFg%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7aa634d6a07c43a69a89283a3e992604&_e=IKWjfp9RtLnb2VmMxFo8LIjYCXdhoxlpZzZLDr_CrxvZ8nZzne3mH9CCFb3hfcQz7ZhVWlMbnHxphdMiEDbFFEC1vlV5YI-_M0I2IMU1N30kVe0VNue1drjFHcuRKzSjazG7oTEHaMILqWzd6fj_S-N6-cTKWxNYiH3iyFJCUQ6UJJ1AQ4Ne3XFPdg3hKhohlCbMSIlJ4pUPnw-UQ3mr1tDQ9_29IEopcmssB8V0lKMsQAm1A9TL88lzQWZEHs8q-lUXL9bKAJMTG7WmuQf9FEFx5fakCXd-MumzxnnulMI8UMAMDv15dQbem6-_CGwFsb2ifAYbinxjBuKyTXmM1qbkk7gYt30RdmWx3Qh7UptlC4JQdpFDmDD2xMbkh6RdcGe3q-wtZTfP4gCln10HzOkEnFqha0On6xtCGNA6g0LIep4M__kN-69ZN7WvMCS-B0Kez98THCElKZksGGqq7Q%3D%3D)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7aa634d6a07c43a69a89283a3e992604&_e=IKWjfp9RtLnb2VmMxFo8LIjYCXdhoxlpZzZLDr_CrxvZ8nZzne3mH9CCFb3hfcQz7ZhVWlMbnHxphdMiEDbFFEC1vlV5YI-_M0I2IMU1N30kVe0VNue1drjFHcuRKzSjazG7oTEHaMILqWzd6fj_S-N6-cTKWxNYiH3iyFJCUQ6UJJ1AQ4Ne3XFPdg3hKhohlCbMSIlJ4pUPnw-UQ3mr1tDQ9_29IEopcmssB8V0lKNAfW4B8nA38vXFjgxUYgCrG43usdvU4GvEMrLmN3Pe9TiC08Y1DWMQ4s38mbnPNNBU4fXv5yqDwTQcVMLJ1bqxnpVMkIwr-r4bkOnujk_lY2tqFfyG_Z_0LpzYBBXxf91yG6Un3G7yAiNsvusHl_APIln_2H1I8nodNj_eRbHqaTVBrDg4osAyRDO3ZrQcH-x9SrISACu3x9a6A_nhWRqhQCzXN2vP-TAYBBa8Ou_PWA%3D%3D)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/79102/images/parker%20logo.jpeg]
A funny thing happened on the way to the FORUM!
It may not have been as funny as the 1966 periodic musical comedy but the amazing volunteer leaders from the White Plains, Mamaroneck, and Scarsdale Democratic Committees hosted a Candidate Forum on July 18th, the first of many forums scheduled over the next month.
The questions were serious and poignant, as we continue to navigate a political climate that ignores the issues and values most important to residents of NY-16. I had the chance to close out the forum with these words:
This election has some real consequences. What I will do for you in Congress, is what I’ve always done. I listen and I vote for you. And I vote as you would want me to vote. We have infrastructure needs, I’ll vote to fund infrastructure. We support our allies like Israel and Ukraine, I would vote for aid. You need federal resources, me and my staff will be dedicated to connect the dots for you. I’m asking for your support because I have 7x the elected experience as the next person in this race. I represent 62,000 people in this district. And on the issues that Democrats care about, I have a long list of accomplishments, progressive legislation with pragmatic results that make a difference in the lives of people. Getting results, even while being in the minority party representing Democrats, I’m the only one who can check that box as we enter the midterms. I believe that in 2022, the Bronx and Westchester voters need to say they know what year it is, and we can send a strong woman to congress who will stand up for us as the rest of the country turns the clock back. I hope you will be standing right there with me.
If you missed it, you can check it out yourself:

The questions were serious and poignant, as we continue to navigate a political climate that ignores the issues and values most important to residents of NY-16. I had the chance to close out the forum with these words: This election has some real consequences. What I will do for you in Congress, is what I’ve always done. I listen and I vote for you. And I vote as you would want me to vote. We have infrastructure needs, I’ll vote to fund infrastructure. We support our allies like Israel and Ukraine, I would vote for aid. You need federal resources, me and my staff will be dedicated to connect the dots for you. I’m asking for your support because I have 7x the elected experience as the next person in this race. I represent 62,000 people in this district. And on the issues that Democrats care about, I have a long list of accomplishments, progressive legislation with pragmatic results that make a difference in the lives of people. Getting results, even while being in the minority party representing Democrats, I’m the only one who can check that box as we enter the midterms. I believe that in 2022, the Bronx and Westchester voters need to say they know what year it is, and we can send a strong woman to congress who will stand up for us as the rest of the country turns the clock back. I hope you will be standing right there with me. subject: BLEXIT vs BLM
body:
I am a Black man, and I’m telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of A
[View this message in your browser](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zhorsagob5jpiuvil741j5m94h1thl6ulfntjsmg_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jk5p7atdge5p78d5jmeqjetjjkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbqn7d9nceoe5dlheuqm2cdgm8o6ao5m6ko66c9nc3h6cd1kegob9d5ge1hnbddgcv970sj2cpob4pjgsipm6o3i61j73cljc1jrep366hgb4pj0s2qm6o70mkoj3d9hmlp238h1e8he4933clgeapj0c3gm0oh5u)
[](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z1oock6hr21ennrci3m0bj4cqtukre2me49ikt4g_rp22sh2s8i66pb0slj60o71c1h2bs)

Friend,

**I am a Black man, and I 'm telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of America - _Black Lives Matter_.**

Now, I know what you're thinking... _What about the KKK, or what about neo-nazis?_

I ask, "what about them is influential?!"

This is 2022. Does the KKK have institutional power like BLM does? Is the KKK receiving millions of dollars from corporations and Hollywood celebrities?

No. They aren't, but BLM is.

BLM claims to speak for Black communities. But all I ever hear from BLM is how much they hate America. They only focus on victimhood to divide us as the greatest nation on Earth. BLM cries out for action, but the only action they do is burn down Black neighborhoods and cozy up to corporations.

I saw the hypocrisy long ago. **That 's why I started the BLEXIT Foundation with Candace Owens. **

**BLEXIT** is a non-profit bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

_Our message to America 's black and minority communities is that you are NOT a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture_.

I believe God has put me on this mission to reach Black communities. I'll tell you the full story of how I cofounded BLEXIT with Candace, but first, I must ask for your immediate support.

[_**Can you please support BLEXIT by sending a gift of $5, $10, $20.22, $100, or any amount you can afford today? Click here to donate >>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2za37derprkfeb4rqfo88af18mifurpsliu988ung_rp22sh2s8i66pb0slj60o71c1h2bs)

**How I Started BLEXIT**

I was an All-American high school football player in Fort Worth, Texas. I accepted a full athletic scholarship from the University of Arizona in 2005. I played at Arizona for five years and entered the NFL Draft in 2010; however, God had other plans.

With my entire family around, I was not drafted. I was so angry. I ripped my shirt off. But, God had other plans for me.

This led me to join the Tucson police force, and it changed my life forever.

I learned what it meant to put my life on the line to save others. I woke up every morning to thank Jesus that I got to live another day to serve. This experience taught me a lot, but it was foundational to learning about the lies of BLM.

Learning that BLM is lying to Black communities and teaching them to hate the police forever changed my opinion on the "Black Lives Matter" organization. But more importantly, I learned not to be a victim. Not getting drafted into the NFL taught me life lessons I wouldn't have learned otherwise. I learned to serve others.

Now, I'm giving back to the Black community to make sure they don't become bought into this toxic victimhood mentality that BLM pushes.

[_**Can you help me reach Black neighborhoods with a message of individualism, freedom, and entrepreneurship? Click here to donate any amount >>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2ziem7nv0g2sk1qojc1lt65g0k1t2smbun8lvagko_rp22sh2s8i66pb0slj60o71c1h2bs)

BLM incites lawlessness. BLEXIT stands for the rule of law.

BLM destroys communities. BLEXIT empowers them.

BLM only sees the color of your skin. BLEXIT sees character.

BLM wants to disrupt families. BLEXT values the nuclear family.

_Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with 42 grassroots chapter programs in 42 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters._

**Here 's how you can help:**

_I am looking to raise $83,000 online to support BLEXIT during this critical year. We must expand our chapters, build new leaders, and reach people within Black communities_.

This is a long game we are playing. If this were a football game, we would only be in the 1st quarter.

BLM thinks they speak for Black communities, but we are taking over quickly and providing real opportunities for our members.

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z7q9shld1p4dktbrkso3og3a87hmq3amo6b164to_rp22sh2s8i66pb0slj60o71c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2za1cksh0hqkt666046ik36qfipcng1u4ngps0qdo_rp22sh2s8i66pb0slj60o71c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zo4t68egsjrcet37aj2lt2dg8p5g037ssghqcq48_rp22sh2s8i66pb0slj60o71c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zdlespm5gv2v28s6d6820ijq55po48r1dh4r2pdo_rp22sh2s8i66pb0slj60o71c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zldquak6ui9bg9ulhrmkh3dr6f19l7im1lvftf1g_rp22sh2s8i66pb0slj60o71c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z53f849jsrqqji9s675itgfkklugn3u7k2m0tn28_rp22sh2s8i66pb0slj60o71c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zl0olid91tc33cg86r76jfvfbujso7nrk2lf000o_rp22sh2s8i66pb0slj60o71c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z69ahcqmqr6t78pa6pdtvql2n4o6crpe44fupnog_rp22sh2s8i66pb0slj60o71c1h2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z9bkvd48qigkmgj43lveohcf0stikom9rc9t7248_rp22sh2s8i66pb0slj60o71c1h2bs)

**HOW BLEXIT Works**

**Step One:** We enter communities no one else dares to go into - Detroit, Baltimore, New Orleans, Houston, etc. We host events and set up chapters of volunteers who build a support network and help get our message of individualism and empowerment to Black neighborhoods.

**Step Two:** We send the best volunteers and chapter members to our Leadership Academy.

We build leaders from the ground up. In fact, our staff is full of stories of activists we hired from the Leadership Academy. They started as a chapter member and now work for us full time.

Other members graduate from the Leadership Academy, and then they go back into their communities to support others or start their own businesses.

As you can see, we are BUILDING neighborhoods, NOT destroying them.

**Step Three:** Our educational content, both online and in-person, is teaching Black communities ideas they will never hear in the mainstream media.

BLEXIT is teaching about individualism, pro-life, school choice, teaching REAL history (not Critical Race Theory), and creating patriotism among Black families.

**Step Four:** We host large events with hundreds, sometimes thousands of attendees. Our events bring music, live entertainment, and education to Black communities.

What I really want to emphasize is this - BLEXIT is a "DO" tank! We are out there meeting people in neighborhoods.

Friend, this is deeply personal for me as a Black man.

We have to save our communities. We must save our country from the toxic and divisive organizations like BLM that are tearing down our businesses and livelihoods.

**So, please, I implore you to send any amount you generously can. We are a 501(c)(3) organization, and your support is tax-deductible. **

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zt3ptqn8cogirpv3483o3qf1e69v22j87659juq8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0slj60o71c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zg66l9hg5liabmcv8bd1ctme7n8dup8tpjmp22tg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0slj60o71c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zfjohp2qvqmfldm143l9t3ss44v84nscebg06be8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0slj60o71c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z7v4oir0r4e5nb0q70rqje17gq9lo63lng5h23so_rp22sh2s8i66pb0slj60o71c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zqunp9175av8d2mmdtbf8a5g509jioisgpkqv1r0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0slj60o71c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zri4p9kks3b21o5am7tabohit2rlnikgh608hu70_rp22sh2s8i66pb0slj60o71c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zl0pkmr50ahlcl0l7vsp8o8k2eocoe85gjhvt6i0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0slj60o71c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z77v0bjs13a2pfe98erv1r06jopvb1rg0cerj6t0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0slj60o71c1h2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z8sjnpl2jhre0ol7cl279grt8vj70edd8phkb660_rp22sh2s8i66pb0slj60o71c1h2bs)

People ask me, "What does BLEXIT mean?"

It is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us.

_" If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim, you become your own oppressor." \- Candace Owens_

We believe in Faith, Freedom, and Family. With those three principles intact, you can find prosperity no matter how your life may have started. And I believe that is what will save us all in the end.

Thank you,

Brandon Tatum
Co-Founder
BLEXIT Foundation

Donald Trump is coming back to Arizona today

Friend –

Donald Trump is coming back to Arizona today, and we expect his hand-picked candidate will be right on stage with him. Trump knows how important this state is and how important our race here is.
That’s why at one of his previous rallies here, he said: “Taking America back begins with kicking Mark Kelly the hell out of the United States Senate.”

And the truth is, if we don’t have the resources we need to win this race, he might get his wish. Millions of dollars have already been spent trying to defeat us, and millions more are coming. If Trump can help flip this seat, he’ll be that much more likely to run in 2024. He might even win.
Sorry to put that thought in your head, but it’s true.

That’s why I need to know if you can make a $5 contribution before Trump arrives. Because when he does, a lot of people from the far right are going to start looking at this race. And after that, those same folks are going to start pouring money into Arizona to try to beat me.

Peter – nurses care about results, not who gets the credit. [**And that is the same mentality Trudy Busch Valentine is going to take with her to the U.S. Senate.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48195870/357287407/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk162-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZDczMTdiMy0xMjBhLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BQUp5TOrqTqUA0RIDeQdjvaJPwJR3-pHBrwk3jipCLQ=)
As nurses, we wash your baby on your best day; we draw your blood on your most uncertain day; we hold your hand on your scariest day; we help you find a solution when you aren't sure if you can even take your next step. Nurses are problem solvers and caregivers. We know how to listen to and comfort families – and we step up to do the less glamorous work that can make all the difference for a patient and their loved ones.
Make no mistake, we nurses take incredible pride in our work – we work hard and know that our impact speaks for itself. **But nurses aren't worried about glory or celebrity. We're only worried about getting the job done.**
**As a former nurse, Trudy Busch Valentine embodies these principles, ideals, and values.** They guide her as a mom, as a volunteer, and as a children's advocate. And in November, she'll bring a nurse's heart and mind to Washington as Missouri's next senator.
With partisanship and extremism running rampant in Washington, Trudy is exactly the leader we need right now. She'll listen with an open heart, build bridges, and focus on healing our country. **But no one gets to Washington alone. Trudy is counting on a grassroots movement of people like you to stand with her and demand a better, more compassionate future.**
**[So please, will you pitch in to send someone to the Senate who will focus on delivering results for your family – not getting sound bites on TV? body:
Dear Friend,
I'm writing this letter to you today because, quite frankly, David Daleiden cannot.
You may remember David as the undercover journalist who spent 30 months investigating and capturing video evidence of Planned Parenthood 's top leadership --- medical directors, national program directors, even its Senior Director of Medical Services -- **callously negotiating the harvesting and sale of aborted baby body parts.**
**And now, he’s been charged with nine bogus felonies.**
**[Which is why I’m asking you to make an emergency donation to the DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND right away.](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=252a7df1d6a94d78a3cb49933f2144ae&_e=o1L0S5PofEY6wTBRIKi98rkdToHpwVBiC-X9fQZLYXvkG0e_uIoV9G3RU7FD74Y0mycwv4b90i6Kf1km8z-249JPee7Q4YcjQrC80JYiRrasMnsU97armoGsCCHagSJGtiuTSAm1EJ_m1qusPph4MZQt-3JnevxLKgSvwHn9lxCfoC3Zl09XkiWcL6MylexaeXRZSpHL4bU8JwRlbXiYHIPwU45d7dBjt5sSdkWeE_USwvvZCje65HeFAb3OGHmawRtmRMhINjuomxIN-RuzriyHOdBmbBIc-7Zcew_axduwRweAKOm9g_-cKuSbUG5UyF5xdVzf5mAhnc73tgw3DXPHp9Dg4NjBbnPp7mFvwP3feOdV699YS4Ib5jbdIMhZBEKqe6GsenmSpJJUtvroUEQn504Pznm7mxRufWF71Kc%3D)**
You see, after David released the shocking videos of the illegal and disgusting actions of abortion executives, Kamala Harris, then California's Attorney General, colluded with Planned Parenthood to file felony charges against David...
_**... Kamala Harris even ordered the California Department of Justice to raid David's home and confiscate his unpublished videos.**_
I won't sugarcoat it. If not cleared of these charges, David faces steep fines and years in state penitentiary and the consequences of being a convicted felon. While Kamala Harris --- a bought-and-paid-for ally of the abortion industry --- is sitting one heartbeat away from the presidency.
That's the bad news.
But here's the good news... David is fighting back.
In fact, he's taking another opportunity to drag more of Planned Parenthood's dark criminality into the spotlight with two new federal lawsuits.
That's right. The Thomas More Society has filed a federal civil rights lawsuit in California on behalf of David against former California Attorney General and now VicePresident Kamala Harris for prosecuting David in bad faith, twisting and perverting California's anti-eavesdropping law to persecute a citizen journalist because of his political views.
Then the Thomas More Society filed a defamation (libel) lawsuit in federal court in New York against Planned Parenthood, which said David created a "fake" and "false" "smear campaign" against Planned Parenthood.
In other words, the best defense is a good offense. The truth is we could no longer let David suffer such a trampling of his free speech and due process rights without a counterattack.
The timing couldn't be more important.
This is a critical opportunity to put Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the rest of the abortion industry on trial for conspiring to silence David in order to cover-up their illegal activities.
**[That's where your emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND comes in --- by giving today you can stand with David in his hour of need.](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=252a7df1d6a94d78a3cb49933f2144ae&_e=o1L0S5PofEY6wTBRIKi98rkdToHpwVBiC-X9fQZLYXvkG0e_uIoV9G3RU7FD74Y0mycwv4b90i6Kf1km8z-249JPee7Q4YcjQrC80JYiRrasMnsU97armoGsCCHagSJGtiuTSAm1EJ_m1qusPph4MZQt-3JnevxLKgSvwHn9lxCfoC3Zl09XkiWcL6MylexaeXRZSpHL4bU8JwRlbXiYHKQS0QGqKcudKiPjLGx2Xw9rDe-oyVyLsz3OKjAz9TYjah_8lZPVIsFeVgxz7H1e53-zRRIxluH5LUpAN-48-9tJIw7nKFC11AEl8c8uFZgTt3-ANonzwScYav3kradYz2I1ejQ3GdxfncQcW00CQv5vT8TWp1EbIjuF4hqAm01BbSTNhvNyHwipLuhewXGO-RL2R3AiVDbIAdDPTQE_rAc%3D)**
The reality is. . .
You couldn't be there when David entered the dark underbelly of the abortion industry --- sitting across the table from abortionists haggling over the price of baby body parts with cold-blooded clarity... "I want a Lamborghini."
You couldn't be there as David saw with his own eyes the preborn children who had been killed with great precision and delicacy to preserve their organs for maximum profit.
You couldn't be there when the videos were released and Kamala Harris and Planned Parenthood conspired to crush David with trumped up legal charges and an armed raid on his home in which they seized laptops, hard-drives, and recording equipment.
And you couldn't be there with David (our criminal defense team was there) when he voluntarily appeared in both Texas and California for booking and processing --- fingerprinted and photographed for a mugshot like a common criminal.

**[You can make an emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND to help vindicate this pro-life hero.](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=252a7df1d6a94d78a3cb49933f2144ae&_e=o1L0S5PofEY6wTBRIKi98rkdToHpwVBiC-X9fQZLYXvkG0e_uIoV9G3RU7FD74Y0mycwv4b90i6Kf1km8z-249JPee7Q4YcjQrC80JYiRrasMnsU97armoGsCCHagSJGtiuTSAm1EJ_m1qusPph4MZQt-3JnevxLKgSvwHn9lxCfoC3Zl09XkiWcL6MylexaeXRZSpHL4bU8JwRlbXiYHB9I-Rh70Xc2l8-uM4-mkCHAfPBmZyxD--9gVBBlb1Ov9pPIeBJDjBjeuGGxaQ1NaAgUCLkdnHZn9rO8vEQ6CWydSV7xeqec18hwCk9exxRkJ95cPzb4zPsU4xuC4uSYEw9EDsVHhoSQQkydZ6ky-gfFwMnlLOg8XwW_TQDUT7vvofnu2Zs4vK5y78pRG5ptXgZaoX1ECVwneTXph2PsjIE%3D)**
My name is Tom Brejcha.
I'm the president and chief counsel of the Thomas More Society --- a not-for-profit law firm underwriting and helping to spearhead David's criminal defense.
The Thomas More Society is proud to have defended many renowned pro-life and religious leaders in America's pro-life movement such as Joe, Ann, and Eric Scheidler, the Pro-Life Action League, Shawn Carney and 40 Days for Life, Abby Johnson, the Susan B. Anthony List, David Bereit, Lila Rose and Live Action, Students for Life, Sidewalk Advocates for Life, Created Equal, former Kansas Attorney General Phill Kline, the March for Life, and many more.
Because when dark forces like Planned Parenthood unleash their full might to legally, financially, and personally destroy our clients --- **we fight back.**
I have to tell you, despite all that David is facing, his spirits remain high. Of course, I've never known anyone in this kind of position who didn't feel an empty pit in his stomach.
But David's not giving up. His willingness to fight back is a true profile in Pro-Life courage.
Now I'll get right down to it...
**We anticipate David's legal defense will cost us more than $6 million. That's right, SIX MILLION DOLLARS.**
In addition to the criminal case and the new federal civil rights and defamation lawsuits, we're currently representing David in THREE other cases.
* The civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood where we are appealing the jury's verdict, along with the judge's order permanently banning David from doing any more undercover journalism against Planned Parenthood. Recently, we posted a $700,000 appeal bond to keep Planned Parenthood’s nasty collection agents from harassing him with collection agents and even seizing his belongings. We’re fighting back, but we’ll need your help.

* The civil lawsuit brought by the National Abortion Federation and the "gag order" injunction that still prohibits David from releasing any more of his video evidence exposing Planned Parenthood's illegal fetal tissue business. And now, in light of the Planned Parenthood civil lawsuit, NAF has moved for summary judgment – they want a ruling against David without a trial at all!

* And finally, the civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood personnel in federal court in Seattle, where we just achieved a victory for a second time on appeal, but it appears we may need at least a third victory on appeal before this case ends.

That's why David needs your financial support today.
**[And that's why I'm praying you will donate $35 or more to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND right away.](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=252a7df1d6a94d78a3cb49933f2144ae&_e=o1L0S5PofEY6wTBRIKi98rkdToHpwVBiC-X9fQZLYXvkG0e_uIoV9G3RU7FD74Y0mycwv4b90i6Kf1km8z-249JPee7Q4YcjQrC80JYiRrasMnsU97armoGsCCHagSJGtiuTSAm1EJ_m1qusPph4MZQt-3JnevxLKgSvwHn9lxCfoC3Zl09XkiWcL6MylexaeXRZSpHL4bU8JwRlbXiYHLo5lIay1fXLXxxV9etlGOL87km6lZZZiRHl6OLOKugNt2KnqyPQJ8v8MrnNnfA75PtBMygRjsMkpt42jMnSQg6EVWSV_cmMgARREquNqwCeP7gOieoqvn1DGKncThi1rVPUbgQOXFZ_enael1AJyqpnegm37XloDMSf2-Qnlfqrxl8NAVPHTKogN-NtT4kPywsOFXL0A3gbqqYkLwWN0fA%3D)**
I won't guess how much you're able to send today. Whether it's $35, $50, $75, $125, $250, $500, $1,000 or more...
... I will only say that time is of the essence.
So I do ask that you make your donation as soon as you can.
**This truly is a "David versus Goliath" type of battle --- with Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the radical left arrayed against our "David."**
It's a grave injustice that David is the one being hit with felony charges and massive civil penalties while Planned Parenthood (so far, at least) has gone unpunished.
By clearing David of these charges... you and I can allow him to continue with his incredibly important lifesaving work. Remember, over 12 million people on YouTube alone watched the shocking footage he captured. Since that time, 26 states --- over half the country -- have moved to strip Planned Parenthood of taxpayer funding.
It's no wonder Planned Parenthood and their allies want to destroy David.
They'd love to see him rotting away in penitentiary rather than exposing their criminal and inhumane activities. You and I cannot let that happen.

This is a critical opportunity to put Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the rest of the abortion industry on trial for conspiring to silence David in order to cover-up their illegal activities. The reality is. . . You couldn't be there when David entered the dark underbelly of the abortion industry --- sitting across the table from abortionists haggling over the price of baby body parts with cold-blooded clarity... "I want a Lamborghini." You couldn't be there as David saw with his own eyes the preborn children who had been killed with great precision and delicacy to preserve their organs for maximum profit. You couldn't be there when the videos were released and Kamala Harris and Planned Parenthood conspired to crush David with trumped up legal charges and an armed raid on his home in which they seized laptops, hard-drives, and recording equipment. And you couldn't be there with David (our criminal defense team was there) when he voluntarily appeared in both Texas and California for booking and processing --- fingerprinted and photographed for a mugshot like a common criminal. But, now, this is the reality... there is something you can do. My name is Tom Brejcha. The Thomas More Society is proud to have defended many renowned pro-life and religious leaders in America's pro-life movement such as Joe, Ann, and Eric Scheidler, the Pro-Life Action League, Shawn Carney and 40 Days for Life, Abby Johnson, the Susan B. Anthony List, David Bereit, Lila Rose and Live Action, Students for Life, Sidewalk Advocates for Life, Created Equal, former Kansas Attorney General Phill Kline, the March for Life, and many more. Because when dark forces like Planned Parenthood unleash their full might to legally, financially, and personally destroy our clients --- we fight back. I have to tell you, despite all that David is facing, his spirits remain high. Of course, I've never known anyone in this kind of position who didn't feel an empty pit in his stomach. But David's not giving up. His willingness to fight back is a true profile in Pro-Life courage. Now I'll get right down to it... We anticipate David's legal defense will cost us more than $6 million. That's right, SIX MILLION DOLLARS. In addition to the criminal case and the new federal civil rights and defamation lawsuits, we're currently representing David in THREE other cases. The civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood where we are appealing the jury's verdict, along with the judge's order permanently banning David from doing any more undercover journalism against Planned Parenthood. Recently, we posted a $700,000 appeal bond to keep Planned Parenthood’s nasty collection agents from harassing him with collection agents and even seizing his belongings. We’re fighting back, but we’ll need your help. body:
The reality is that the GOP has a real chance to take back power in Congress.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220722-3243-header&t=1&akid=3243%2E2526796%2EZF15HH)
Last night’s January 6 hearing cemented just how dangerous Donald Trump and some of Alexandria’s current GOP colleagues are.
Donald Trump refused to take _any_ action to call off the violence despite numerous pleas from his staff and family.1 Meanwhile, Republican Sen. Josh Hawley – who sold t-shirts of himself fist-pumping the violent mob as recently as *this year* – was seen running from the rioters in never-before-seen footage.2
Last month, surveillance footage showed Representative Barry Loudermilk giving a tour of the Capitol _the day before the attack_ to a group that included an insurrectionist.3
You’d think these actions would disqualify them from running for re-election, let alone winning, but the reality is that the GOP has a real chance to take back power in Congress.
**That’s why Alexandria is fighting for accountability for the representatives who were complicit in the January 6 attack; who put her and all of her colleagues in danger of losing their lives.**
[If you want to help us demand accountability and fight back against the GOP’s disinformation machine, please chip in today so we can expose the truth and protect our majority. ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220722.eoFtb5&refcode=em20220722-3243-P_FND_EGR_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3243%2E2526796%2EZF15HH)

When Alexandria shared her experience of January 6, the conservative disinformation machine didn’t waste a minute accusing her of ‘overreacting’ or ‘exaggerating’.
We believed Alexandria then, and the facts and evidence shown since she shared her story just confirm what we already knew: That this was not a small attack carried out by a small group of people. The threat was real and intentional.
Republicans are trying to walk away from this. They’re trying to pretend it didn’t happen. It’s our responsibility to remember and hold them accountable in November.

Friend, if you turn on the news, there's a good chance you'll hear my name.
Typically, it's alongside a dishonest legacy media headline misrepresenting my agenda, insulting the people of Florida, or implying FREEDOM is the latest and greatest threat to America.
It is an insulting and absurd way to distort the truth and mislead you, the American public.
Their attempts at intimidation won't work on me though. I am not backing down. Not even a little bit.
I welcome the "insults" and the hard work to refute them because I know the importance of strong leadership in a time like this. That is why I'm running for re-election, and I hope you'll [**pledge your support for my campaign.**](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=70300c2d9ebb43d7a0dd295fb684b956&_e=FdYbSgxMEgOJZdJWrwAuQ46gN1-o4lU8SyLAKfTEn-6Q1fWLlBnFtZCM_7t60kpAdkDk4clUM-FzkqVjNcvIXvP1LPbps3tTc2rWAZblnJtUIjgLtVV1_cFmGA-ntDj7TDjydaJm0FHAWEWVcXXio48FeeGE-gC0-AaMnd0IMna-aaly0QCBQ2qbzfoH6GSRY37Zf8deU9sQywfe7BlmF4D9SJO4toljQiPcL3CyHsbjxZMWKxEoc5snByDN7RRjNM6UaQgcKTWom3h8xEO4pfY2LuUi2ONhP_hy_bbq7CC-5_LvN59mypKE68h5S2GMsTHclgCXgDy0xAEe4ERcGHGBOua9xNMHPE90aII6dpGCSd7LgE3dZsWuZyx3Fojaqq4TF1HQWPbz747p-Cawdw%3D%3D)
If you're still hesitant about getting involved, I'd like to remind you what we're up against. It is evident how far to the left the media has gone by looking at how they define "radical."
* Allowing grown men and women to assess personal risk and decide to wear a mask or not: **RADICAL.**
* Allowing CHILDREN under 9 years old to make life-altering, sometimes irreversible, decisions about their "gender identity": _**JUST FINE!**_
* Encouraging an educational environment focused on learning and preparing students for the real world: **RADICAL.**
* Encouraging students to hate themselves, their peers, and our country: _**JUST FINE!**_

The stakes could not be higher.
These out-of-touch liberal elites are so threatened by rational thought that they will call me radical for standing with everyday people on the side of common sense and sanity. If that makes me a radical, so be it.
I will always defend our liberty, protect our children, and promote the ideals of our Constitution which make our country the greatest on earth. No amount of intimidation or petty name-calling is going to change that.

body:
Get engaged with the DNC next week! | | | |
---
| | |
---
| Dear Friends,

Join Senator Elizabeth Warren and the Democratic National Committee in launching a youth virtual training series to prepare you with skills and resources to organize your community ahead of the midterms!

Join us on _Wednesdays from 7-8 PM ET/4-5 PM PT!_ Sessions will deep dive into the building blocks of organizing and youth contact strategies.

Following the completion of the series, attendees will be provided meaningful volunteer opportunities to make a difference in critical 2022 races in their communities & through the DNC's Fair Shot Youth Program. Sign up at the button below!
---
| [Sign Up Here](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=212e79b133&e=d6c5c7d7ec "Sign Up Here")
---
|
---
| Please join the Democratic National Committee’s Disability Caucus and its Chair, Kerri Harris, for a virtual celebration of the 32nd anniversary of the Americans with Disabilities Act. The event will be held on _Monday, July 25 at 7pm ET._ The ADA has been a critical lifeline for those in the disability community and well worth a special celebration every year!
Special guests will include DNC Chair Jaime Harrison, DNC Vice Chair Sen. Tammy Duckworth, Second Gentleman Doug Emhoff, and a panel of experts who will discuss the challenges we face as many state legislatures restrict voting access in the upcoming elections. Our goal is to discuss solutions we can undertake that will keep our community active and continue to make an electoral difference for candidates who support disability rights. Please sign up for this exciting event!
To RSVP, please click the button below. If you have any questions, please reach out to the DNC’s Disability Coalition Advisor Rob Engel at [EngelR@dnc.org](mailto:EngelR@dnc.org).

ASL and closed captioning will be provided. Thank you!

_The DNC complies with federal and state disability laws and makes reasonable accommodations for meeting participants. To request a reasonable accommodation please indicate in the registration form._
---
| [RSVP Here](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=ab9db4dd2f&e=d6c5c7d7ec "RSVP Here")
---
|
---
| **ICYMI: President Biden Addresses Effects of Climate Change with Executive Action**
This week, President Biden announced his latest set of executive actions to turn the climate crisis into an opportunity, by creating good-paying jobs in clean energy and lowering costs for families. His actions will protect communities from climate impacts already here, including extreme heat conditions impacting more than 100 million Americans this week, and expand offshore wind opportunities and jobs in the United States. You can learn more about the President's actions at the link below.

Tonight, Donald Trump is coming back to Arizona. He knows how important this state is, and he knows how important our race is.
| | | Friends —

In just a few hours, Donald Trump is coming back to Arizona and we expect his hand-picked candidate will be right on stage with him. Trump knows how important this state is, and how important our race is.

That’s why at one of his previous rallies here, he said: “Taking America back begins with kicking Mark Kelly the hell out of the United States Senate.”

And the truth is, if we don’t have the resources we need to win this race, he might get his wish. Millions of dollars have already been spent trying to defeat us, and millions more are coming. If Trump can help flip this seat, he’ll be that much more likely to run in 2024. He might even win.

Sorry to put that thought in your head, but it’s true.

name: Dan Farough
subject: Here’s an analogy
disclaimer_text:
Paid for by
Jocelyn Benson for Secretary of State
body:
Hey friend,

I’ve been a big baseball fan my whole life. And as much as I’ve tried to separate my mindset on the baseball diamond from my work in politics, the parallels between the two can sometimes be striking.

So here’s an analogy for you, friend. There are almost 100 days left until Election Day. That means we’re getting close to the home stretch. I’d put us right around the 7th inning. We’re not quite ready to close out the final three outs of the game, but we’ve got a nice lead and a couple more innings to build on it, so there’s no surprises in the ninth.
Now we’ve all seen what can happen to our favorite team in those later innings. They take their foot off the gas a little bit, the opponent strings together a couple runs, and suddenly the ninth inning becomes an absolute nailbiter.

But this is no game, folks. This is a matchup between Jocelyn Benson, a dedicated service-driven leader who has overseen the most safe, secure, and transparent election in Michigan history – and an election-denying conspiracy theorist.

If we take our foot off the gas, and lose our momentum, our very democracy will be put at risk. Will you pitch in today to help ensure we have the resources to keep the momentum up and come away victorious on Election Day?

| | Peter, This past weekend, we had over 175 volunteers and supporters participate in our most recent Weekend of Action - knocking doors, making calls and showing up in Cherokee, Clay, Transylvania and Buncombe counties. The numbers are impressive, but I think what really struck Jasmine, our supporters, and our whole team was the energy. I’ve been working on and leading campaigns full-time for the last seven plus years, and there is always a moment on winning races where something routine starts to feel incredibly special. It is as if, all of a sudden, there is an unspoken agreement between everyone on the team - from the voters to the supporters to the staff to the candidate, that we are all in to win this, together. That’s what it felt like last weekend. **Our whole team is fired up, and the voters are responding to our message. body:
My opponent is a multi-millionaire with hundreds of thousands of dollars from special interests behind his campaign, and that's simply not who I am. | |
---
| | | [ ](https://pennyronning.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05c2d51066158a4f5219d9967&id=59f3d4ea0d&e=2f4ec52c5e)
---
| | | Peter Willis,

My opponent, Matt Rosendale, is a multi-millionaire with hundreds of thousands of dollars from special interests behind his campaign, and that's simply not who I am.

This campaign has always been, and will always be, a people-powered grassroots movement to fight for the Montana values we all hold so close to our hearts like hard work, freedom, and hope.
* I'm fighting to lower the price at the pump because Rosendale won't.
* I'm fighting to fix our crumbling roads and bridges because Rosendale won't.
* I'm fighting to lower rising housing costs because Rosendale won't.

However, I can't keep fighting without your help. We need [volunteers](https://pennyronning.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05c2d51066158a4f5219d9967&id=05e33c6b58&e=2f4ec52c5e) to knock on doors, people to [chip in](https://pennyronning.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05c2d51066158a4f5219d9967&id=68553ccc60&e=2f4ec52c5e) to support our efforts, and more.

I know not all folks have time to volunteer so I ask that you give me an hour of your time in a different way.

[__**Montana's minimum wage is $9.20, so to help me keep fighting can I count on you to make a recurring donation of an hour of your time each month?**__](https://pennyronning.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05c2d51066158a4f5219d9967&id=8fdad454d4&e=2f4ec52c5e)

Thank you and together we rise!

name: =?utf-8?Q?Congressman=20Troy=20Carter?=
subject: See You On The Campaign Trail
body:
After being elected to serve the people of Louisiana’s 2nd congressional district just over a year ago, I’m eager to continue fighting in Washington. |
---
| | [ ](https://congressmantroycarter.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47f144cfbca3f0c81de469f60&id=c84575be44&e=dd5c2df611)
---
| | Friend,

After being elected to serve the people of Louisiana’s second congressional district just over a year ago, [__**I’m eager to continue fighting in Washington D.C.**__](https://congressmantroycarter.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47f144cfbca3f0c81de469f60&id=2cecc05853&e=dd5c2df611) because we’ve made progress on some of the biggest issues impacting our state.

I helped secure an over $7.2 billion investment in roads, bridges, coastal protection, internet, ports, and more. This investment includes earmarks for projects across the district including $30 million for upgrades to the Veterans Memorial Bridge in Gramercy, $4.75 million for hurricane protection on the Jefferson Parish Lake Pontchartrain Lakefront, $783 million for the storm damage risk reduction levee infrastructure in New Orleans, and more.

[__**Can I count on you to chip in $50 so I can keep fighting to fix our crumbling roads and protect our communities from hurricanes?**__](https://congressmantroycarter.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47f144cfbca3f0c81de469f60&id=dc07f7befc&e=dd5c2df611)

To help our businesses recover from the COVID-19 pandemic, I introduced the Revitalizing Small and Local Businesses Act which would create a new program to get resources into the hands of the local organizations that help our small businesses thrive. I also co-sponsored a bill to provide $60 billion in new funding to help restaurants recover.
---
| [ ](https://congressmantroycarter.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47f144cfbca3f0c81de469f60&id=422159a050&e=dd5c2df611)
---
| In the face of violence across our nation and in our region, I co-sponsored the Protecting Our Kids Act, which prohibits the sale of semi-automatic firearms to people under 21 years old, regulates ghost guns, establishes new gun trafficking laws, and more.

[__**Will you chip in $50 to help me ensure our kids are safe in the schools they love?**__](https://congressmantroycarter.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47f144cfbca3f0c81de469f60&id=da93cb899c&e=dd5c2df611)

After Hurricane Ida, I fought to bring national attention to the devastation in our region and secured recovery funding for hard-hit communities like Jefferson Parish.

Outside of supporting the American Rescue Plan’s major framework to bring our economy back from COVID-19 equitably, I ensured that it included USDA loan forgiveness for socially disadvantaged farmers in the River Parishes.

In addition, I supported efforts to invest $555 billion in climate, clean energy jobs, and environmental justice; voted in favor of legislation to codify reproductive rights; cosponsored legislation to prevent federal funding from going to “conversion” therapy; and fought to ensure communities like Gretna were not hurt by poorly planned infrastructure projects.

[__**Chip in $50 so I can continue to be a voice for environmental justice, reproductive rights, LGBTQ+ rights, and more. **__](https://congressmantroycarter.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47f144cfbca3f0c81de469f60&id=c0920b9099&e=dd5c2df611)

With hope,
---

##
22 July 22

**Jeff Warner Wins! The people of District 4 Win!**

While the "official" election results have not been declared, major media outlets are reporting Jeff Warner has won the Republican nomination for District 4.
[Associated Press](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e2b757c427e67a891eab3e1b8&id=7212a56a28&e=12a37459a2)
[Washington Post](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e2b757c427e67a891eab3e1b8&id=8c2c38d31f&e=12a37459a2)
[US News & World Report](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e2b757c427e67a891eab3e1b8&id=ef5f429b23&e=12a37459a2)
[WTOP](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e2b757c427e67a891eab3e1b8&id=27dc3694da&e=12a37459a2)

Jeff shared, "This is not just a personal victory, it is more importantly a victory for the people in MD4. For the first time in 35 years, they have a real voice and a real choice to lower inflation, lower gas prices, lower crime and so much more. The people will vote policy over party and they will win!"

We have 12 weeks until mail-in ballots are sent. We need All Hands On Deck! Please suspend your disbelief, have faith and act. Join the movement!

We are asking you for your donations and your service. Together, we can do this! This is the power of teamwork! And the Best Is Yet To Come!

Phase II begins now. In 15 weeks, we'll know the results of the General Election. Let's Get This Done! Together!

[**Donate Here**](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e2b757c427e67a891eab3e1b8&id=f32424871e&e=12a37459a2)

Remember, Jeff Warner is standing with you and for you. Enough is Enough! Together, "We The People" can make a real difference. Now is our time to act. THERE IS HOPE!

Standing with you,

Jeff

Good evening, team. Ned Miller here, Wes Moore and Aruna Miller's campaign manager. I wanted to give you a quick update on the campaign and state of the race. **First — we feel very confident that in the near future Wes Moore will be declaring victory and he will be the Democratic nominee for governor of Maryland.** But as you’ve seen, the mail in ballot counting process can be a little confusing. So, where do things stand? Ballots are still being counted. There is a process in place and we want to honor that process. Yesterday we had a significant lead of over 30,000 votes and today we have a lead of over 30,000 votes. It’s possible this lead will go up, it’s possible this lead will go down, and it’s important to remember that each county is counting ballots at different times and reporting results at different rates. Today, we were very encouraged to see three different network news outlets call the race for Wes. **Looking ahead, it’s very important Democrats come together because Dan Cox is a threat to the future of Maryland and all Maryland families.** We appreciate the kind words already delivered by Comptroller Franchot who ran an admirable campaign along with his running mate Council member Monique Anderson-Walker.
